# **THIS WEEK IN BETSY BRIGADE NEWS**
### _Putting the People Back in Charge

_
* * *
### **Betsy Meets with Portland Bar and Restaurant Owners**
Thanks to the downtown Portland bar and restaurant owners who came out to talk with Betsy this week about the challenges they’ve faced with public safety, crime, the decline of activity and foot traffic, and the ongoing anti-business attitude of state and city leaders. As governor, Betsy will help clean up the city, prioritize public safety, and have the backs of business owners to restore Portland to its former glory.
* * *
### **Fox News:** **I'm Betsy Johnson: This is why I want Oregon's vote in the midterm election**

subject: I am writing to ask you to contribute $3 to Mandela Barnes' campaign for U.S. Senate. We need to help Mandela win in Wisconsin in order to expand the Senate majority. And we need more leaders like Mandela who will take on big-money interests and fight for working families. So please, chip in to his campaign today. Thanks. - B
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Mandela Barnes for Wisconsin
body:
#
Friends -
I'm writing to ask if you can make a $3 contribution to Mandela Barnes' campaign for U.S. Senate in Wisconsin. But first, I hope you will give me a chance to explain why your contribution is so important — especially today.
Here is the truth:
Defending and expanding the Senate majority depends on what happens in Wisconsin. And right now our job must be to elect more leaders like Mandela who are prepared to stand up for working families and take on big-money interests.
We are living in a moment where the people on top are doing phenomenally well while working people are struggling. We've got more income and wealth inequality today than at any time in the history of this country.
Yet in the midst of this struggle, now is not the time for despair. Now is the time for us to come together and fight back.
I am proud to support Mandela Barnes for U.S. Senate in Wisconsin because he is someone with the guts to take on the billionaire class and large corporations that have so much political and economic power in our country. If we can elect Mandela in November, it will not only help Democrats retain control of the Senate. It will also give us a strong voice fighting for working families.
Mandela is in a very close race against Ron Johnson and he needs your support to have the financial resources to win in November. Because there's only one way we will flip this Senate seat — and that is together.
That's why I am asking you directly:
[**Please make a $3 contribution to Mandela Barnes' campaign today to help send him to the U.S. Senate and expand the Democratic majority. This is important.**](https://act.mandelabarnes.com/go/1212?c0=mandela-em-oct22.Zk_Uo1&refcode=em221022-4-acq-sp3&t=1&akid=3734%2E196590%2EZ_aQjP)
_If you 've saved payment info with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:_
[Express Donate: $3](https://act.mandelabarnes.com/go/1272?c0=mandela-em-oct22.R5mi9l&refcode=em221022-4-acq-sp3&t=20&akid=3734%2E196590%2EZ_aQjP)
[Express Donate: $25](https://act.mandelabarnes.com/go/1273?c0=mandela-em-oct22.EgXJNr&refcode=em221022-4-acq-sp3&t=21&akid=3734%2E196590%2EZ_aQjP)
[Express Donate: $50](https://act.mandelabarnes.com/go/1274?c0=mandela-em-oct22.9S-_mg&refcode=em221022-4-acq-sp3&t=22&akid=3734%2E196590%2EZ_aQjP)
[Express Donate: $100](https://act.mandelabarnes.com/go/1275?c0=mandela-em-oct22.vyE4YF&refcode=em221022-4-acq-sp3&t=23&akid=3734%2E196590%2EZ_aQjP)
[Express Donate: $250](https://act.mandelabarnes.com/go/1266?c0=mandela-em-oct22.TLNN8P&refcode=em221022-4-acq-sp3&t=24&akid=3734%2E196590%2EZ_aQjP)
[Or donate another amount](https://act.mandelabarnes.com/go/1212?c0=mandela-em-oct22.Zk_Uo1&refcode=em221022-4-acq-sp3&t=25&akid=3734%2E196590%2EZ_aQjP)
As you know, Democrats currently control the Senate. But we don't have the votes needed to pass important legislation that the American people want, and that our country needs.
But if we can expand the Senate majority in November by electing Mandela Barnes, we will be in a position to finally have the votes to pass meaningful legislation that addresses the needs of the working class.
Mandela Barnes understands that the rich and large corporations must pay their fair share of taxes.
He understands that we must raise the minimum wage to a living wage of at least $15 an hour.
He understands that we need to lower the outrageous cost of prescription drugs.
He understands that we've got to make childcare, pre-K, and higher education more affordable.
He understands that we've got to defend abortion rights and codify Roe v. Wade into law.
And he understands that we've got to protect the right to vote and ensure all eligible voters can participate in the political process.
If we can elect Mandela Barnes to the Senate, we will have a critical vote to help pass legislation to address a number of important issues.
But if Republicans regain the majority in the Senate, they plan to pass more tax breaks for the ultra-wealthy, a national ban on abortion, and cut Medicare and Social Security. That would be a complete disaster.
With control of the Senate on the line, Mandela Barnes is in a strong position to win a Republican-held seat and expand the majority. But only if people like you stand with him during these final days before Election Day.
That is why I need to ask you one more time:
[**Please make a $3 contribution to Mandela Barnes' campaign today to help send him to the U.S. Senate and defend the Democratic majority. This is important.**](https://act.mandelabarnes.com/go/1212?c0=mandela-em-oct22.Zk_Uo1&refcode=em221022-4-acq-sp3&t=26&akid=3734%2E196590%2EZ_aQjP)
We must never stop fighting for the kind of country we know we can become. Thank you for contributing to help Mandela win in Wisconsin and expand the Senate majority.
In solidarity,
Bernie Sanders

But first, I hope you will give me a chance to explain why your contribution is so important — especially today. Here is the truth: Defending and expanding the Senate majority depends on what happens in Wisconsin. And right now our job must be to elect more leaders like Mandela who are prepared to stand up for working families and take on big-money interests. We are living in a moment where the people on top are doing phenomenally well while working people are struggling. We've got more income and wealth inequality today than at any time in the history of this country. Yet in the midst of this struggle, now is not the time for despair. Now is the time for us to come together and fight back. I am proud to support Mandela Barnes for U.S. Senate in Wisconsin because he is someone with the guts to take on the billionaire class and large corporations that have so much political and economic power in our country. If we can elect Mandela in November, it will not only help Democrats retain control of the Senate. It will also give us a strong voice fighting for working families. Mandela is in a very close race against Ron Johnson and he needs your support to have the financial resources to win in November. Because there's only one way we will flip this Senate seat — and that is together. That's why I am asking you directly: If you 've saved payment info with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: As you know, Democrats currently control the Senate. But we don't have the votes needed to pass important legislation that the American people want, and that our country needs. But if we can expand the Senate majority in November by electing Mandela Barnes, we will be in a position to finally have the votes to pass meaningful legislation that addresses the needs of the working class. He understands that we need to lower the outrageous cost of prescription drugs. He understands that we've got to make childcare, pre-K, and higher education more affordable. He understands that we've got to defend abortion rights and codify Roe v. Wade into law. If we can elect Mandela Barnes to the Senate, we will have a critical vote to help pass legislation to address a number of important issues. That is why I need to ask you one more time: We must never stop fighting for the kind of country we know we can become. name: Candace Owens
subject: I’ve received death threats… here’s why
body:
[](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61719170:6CFXHgVNg:m:1:3331703221:2386F2E81AA48920EF1D010AB49D6DA5:r)

Hello Peter,

I've dealt with racism before. . . I've even received death threats.

All because I am a Black woman with conservative values and because I believe that Black communities can overcome the victimhood mentality.

I've watched Black Americans force-fed a message of victimhood, fear, defeat, and dependence for almost my entire life. Growing up, I remember being told I was "helpless."

This message -- which the media forces Black Americans to listen to -- is heartbreaking. _And it needs to stop_.

I co-founded the BLEXIT Foundation with Brandon Tatum to promote economic independence and individual freedom, strengthen the nuclear family, and foster a deeper appreciation for patriotism in Black American culture.

Our message to America's Black and minority communities is, _**" You don't have to be a victim."**_

[_**Will you please support the BLEXIT Foundation 's mission by helping me reach our goal of raising $50,000 from new online donors this month? You can **__**click here to donate >>>**_](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61719170:6CFXHgVNg:m:1:3331703221:2386F2E81AA48920EF1D010AB49D6DA5:r)

Black communities are taught to believe that we're victims, that nothing will ever change, that police are our enemies, and that racism prevents us from ever achieving our goals.

This is WRONG! Giving up and becoming a victim is never the solution.

It's why BLEXIT is NOT just a "think tank," but a thoughtful and quick-acting "DO-tank." _**That 's all thanks to our BLEXIT State Chapters. **_

Our Chapters spread the universal principles of the movement at the local, grassroots level through community service, social engagement, educational activities, and virtual events.

Since 2019, BLEXIT has grown to reach 42 states with over 14,000 volunteers.

Peter, I am humbly asking you to support BLEXIT and help us spread our winning message of entrepreneurship, school choice, faith, and family. My goal is to raise $50,000 this week to support our mission.

[_**Please click here to donate $25, $50, $100, $250, $500, $1,000 or any amount >>>**_](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61719170:6CFXHgVNg:m:1:3331703221:2386F2E81AA48920EF1D010AB49D6DA5:r)

Here are the BLEXIT Foundation's values, what we're doing to reach Black communities, and what we're fighting for:

* School Choice: Often, the people allegedly "fighting for minorities" are doing everything in their power to keep Black and Hispanic students locked into awful schools.

The ugly truth is that these schools are simply brainwashing centers attacking the nuclear family, creating victims, and teaching their twisted values.

BLEXIT Chapters promote and encourage others to seek alternative educational opportunities in their local communities. Educational opportunities for America's low-income and minority children and empower them to learn real skills, have more opportunities, and escape poverty.

[_**You can support BLEXIT 's efforts to fight for School Choice here >>>**_
](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61719170:6CFXHgVNg:m:1:3331703221:2386F2E81AA48920EF1D010AB49D6DA5:r)
* Criminal Justice Reform: The mainstream media wants urban communities to hate our law enforcement officers, and this ugly message is setting Black Americans back.

Yes, we do need criminal justice reform. But we believe cooperating with our police officers and connecting as a community is critical to creating justice.

BLEXIT Chapter members lead educational programs to help communities avoid incarceration and foster better relationships between police officers and urban communities.

[_**Help the BLEXIT Foundation change the narrative by donating here >>>**_](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61719170:6CFXHgVNg:m:1:3331703221:2386F2E81AA48920EF1D010AB49D6DA5:r)

* Entrepreneurship: Free markets, responsibility, and advancing the careers of urban communities is the solution to poverty. The BLEXIT Foundation identifies young leaders in urban communities and helps them create resumes, practice interviews, and learn skills employers desire.

BLEXIT is not just talking a big game. . . Our Chapter members are actually connecting with community individuals to make a real impact in urban communities.

[_**Please help the BLEXIT Foundation encourage entrepreneurship and empower Black and Hispanic communities by donating here >>>**_](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61719170:6CFXHgVNg:m:1:3331703221:2386F2E81AA48920EF1D010AB49D6DA5:r)

* Teaching History: Critical Race Theory has nothing to do with solving race relations in our country. This is about division and spreading a victimhood message.

The BLEXIT Foundation believes in teaching real American history. Our urban communities must learn about our Founding Fathers and the Constitution to become productive and educated citizens.

It's why BLEXIT holds summer and after-school programs to teach children about these important lessons.

[_**Please help the BLEXIT Foundation teach real American history by donating here >>>**_](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61719170:6CFXHgVNg:m:1:3331703221:2386F2E81AA48920EF1D010AB49D6DA5:r)

* Presenting Our Message: The BLEXIT Foundation is going places where no one else goes. We're hosting events in Detroit, Baltimore, and Tampa and starting real conversations. These are urban communities that others ignore, communities that rely on the mainstream media to write their narrative.

These aren't boring events, and we're not just preaching to the choir. They have music, art, and real conversations. Most importantly, they are fun!

These exciting events are brought to life because of our State Chapters. Their hard work and creativity help our message reach new people and inspires communities to be victors, not victims.

[_**Please support BLEXIT 's events and help us spread our message by donating here >>>**_](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61719170:6CFXHgVNg:m:1:3331703221:2386F2E81AA48920EF1D010AB49D6DA5:r)

This is personal to me -- I was once a slave to a culture of victimhood, but now I found my exit.

BLEXIT is the Black exit from the culture of victimhood, fear, and dependence forced upon us.**If you hold a permanent view of yourself as a victim, you become your own oppressor.**

Peter, I am asking you to join the BLEXIT Foundation by investing in our organization and helping us reach our goal of raising $50,000 this week. **Please click below to send your gift.**

[_**Donate $25 >>>**_](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61719171:6CFXHgVNg:m:1:3331703221:2386F2E81AA48920EF1D010AB49D6DA5:r)
[_**Donate $35 >>>**_](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61719172:6CFXHgVNg:m:1:3331703221:2386F2E81AA48920EF1D010AB49D6DA5:r)
[_**Donate $50 >>>**_](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61719173:6CFXHgVNg:m:1:3331703221:2386F2E81AA48920EF1D010AB49D6DA5:r)
[_**Donate $100 >>>**_](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61719174:6CFXHgVNg:m:1:3331703221:2386F2E81AA48920EF1D010AB49D6DA5:r)
[_**Donate $250 >>>**_](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61719175:6CFXHgVNg:m:1:3331703221:2386F2E81AA48920EF1D010AB49D6DA5:r)
[_**Donate $500 >>>**_](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61719176:6CFXHgVNg:m:1:3331703221:2386F2E81AA48920EF1D010AB49D6DA5:r)
[_**Donate $1,000 >>>**_](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61719177:6CFXHgVNg:m:1:3331703221:2386F2E81AA48920EF1D010AB49D6DA5:r)
[_**Donate $2,500 >>>**_](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61719178:6CFXHgVNg:m:1:3331703221:2386F2E81AA48920EF1D010AB49D6DA5:r)
[_**Donate Any Amount >>>**_](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61719170:6CFXHgVNg:m:1:3331703221:2386F2E81AA48920EF1D010AB49D6DA5:r)

The BLEXIT Foundation believes in faith, family, and freedom. At the end of the day, our message to urban communities is about love and empowerment.

Thank you, Peter.

Candace Owens
Co-Founder & President
BLEXIT Foundation

subject: a real mess on our hands…

body:
Peter, this is John Kennedy.
My friend President Donald J. Trump and I are cut from the same cloth in a lot of ways. We both can smell BS from a mile away and we don't trust the Liberal Media further than we can throw them.
_We 're all busy people -- you too, Peter -- we don't have time to mess around!_
So let me level with you: I just got off the phone with some old Conservative buddies of mine in the House. They told me they're about to miss the FINAL deadline before the election...
**We 'd have a real mess on our hands if they can't make up some ground before then. It could cost us the entire election if I'm being honest. **
[**With respect, I 'm writing to you in the last few hours to humbly ask for a couple bucks before time officially runs out. Do you think you could find it in your heart to do that for me? **](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61719696:JzR1igVpN:m:1:3371220873:401F2CAC728FE1D5A80E58B542F903BA:r)
The last major deadline of an election is always important but now I'm hearing Republicans are behind by 8 million bucks, Pelosi is using her fundraising lead to HAMMER battleground states with Fake News and anti-Trump propaganda, and now we're behind the polls.
**I 'm worried missing this last deadline could lose us the House AND Senate. That's not something I'm willing to gamble, so we really need your help right now.**
**[Pitch In Ten Bucks->](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61719697:JzR1igVpN:m:1:3371220873:401F2CAC728FE1D5A80E58B542F903BA:r)
[Pitch In Twenty Bucks ->](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61719698:JzR1igVpN:m:1:3371220873:401F2CAC728FE1D5A80E58B542F903BA:r)
[Pitch In Thirty Bucks (Folks Usually Give This Much) ->](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61719699:JzR1igVpN:m:1:3371220873:401F2CAC728FE1D5A80E58B542F903BA:r)
[Pitch In Fifty Bucks ->](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61719700:JzR1igVpN:m:1:3371220873:401F2CAC728FE1D5A80E58B542F903BA:r)
[Pitch In Any Amount -> ](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61719701:JzR1igVpN:m:1:3371220873:401F2CAC728FE1D5A80E58B542F903BA:r)**
If you're still deciding whether to step up or not, please remember how many top Conservatives have sounded the alarm recently:
\-- Ron DeSantis
\-- Sarah Huckabee Sanders
\-- Jim Jordan
\-- Kevin McCarthy
\-- Elise Stefanik
\-- Donald Trump Jr.
\-- Newt Gingrich
\-- Ron Johnson
I know I'm not the only email in your inbox but this is the single best way to communicate in a pinch. We're not where we need to be and our deadline is CLOSING IN. So I'm asking you one last time before it's too late:
[**Can we count on your badly-needed support? I hope so because I 'm afraid we're completely out of options. **](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61719696:JzR1igVpN:m:1:3371220873:401F2CAC728FE1D5A80E58B542F903BA:r)
God bless you,
Senator John N. Kennedy
* * *
[](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61719702:JzR1igVpN:m:1:3371220873:401F2CAC728FE1D5A80E58B542F903BA:r)
Can you keep this between us? Pollsters, pundits, and the media are saying the unthinkable -- _Pelosi and the Democrats have a chance to defeat us. And with hundreds of millions of dollars in their war chest to spend attacking us -- they 're going ALL IN._
We'll say it straight: we're being outraised. And if we sit here and do nothing, Pelosi and the Democrats will buy this election from under us. [**If you 've been waiting to step up, now is the time. Everything President Trump worked so hard to build -- our Conservative Supreme Court Majority, a secure border, a booming economy, HIS ENTIRE LEGACY -- is on the line.**](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61719702:JzR1igVpN:m:1:3371220873:401F2CAC728FE1D5A80E58B542F903BA:r)
We still have time to turn things around, but we need to act fast. Whether we win or lose will come down to what you do in this moment.
\-- Steve Scalise, House Republican Whip

subject: Collierville needs fair representation. I'm running to strengthen our democracy.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Friends of Emily Fulmer Campaign; Katy Ramsey, Treasurer
body:
www.collierville4all.com [www.collierville4all.com]
October 24, 2022
Dear friend,
Imagine every time you go to vote in your local elections, you can't even get one person you prefer elected to the town council. That's exactly how it feels to live on the south side of the railroad tracks in Collierville. We have never elected an Alderman or Mayor from the south side of town.
Since the 1980s, Collierville folks have been saying that our town's at-large elections make it almost impossible for minority candidates to get elected.They are correct! At-large elections lead to poor representation, lack of transparency, and a board of aldermen that vote unanimously 99.5% of the time.
We need to update our election rules in Collierville so that everyone can get fair representation no matter where they live, what they look like, or how much money they make.
I'm running for Collierville Alderman Position 4 because I believe that fair representation is the foundation of a healthy democracy! My #1 goal is to ensure that Collierville residents will keep fighting for fair elections no matter what happens on election night.
SUPPORT FAIR REPRESENTATION IN COLLIERVILLE BY DONATING TO OUR CAMPAIGN [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/collierville4all]
I need your help to reach 5,000 more voters in Collierville during early voting to let them know that we don't have to keep waiting for good representation, we can make the rules fairer anytime we want to. We just need leaders who will make it a priority.
Can you donate to our campaign [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/collierville4all] to help us reach 5,000 voters in the next 10 days? We can work towards better representation in Collierville with your support.
Thank you for your support,

clean_body: www.collierville4all.com [www.collierville4all.com] October 24, 2022 Dear friend, Imagine every time you go to vote in your local elections, you can't even get one person you prefer elected to the town council. That's exactly how it feels to live on the south side of the railroad tracks in Collierville. We have never elected an Alderman or Mayor from the south side of town. Since the 1980s, Collierville folks have been saying that our town's at-large elections make it almost impossible for minority candidates to get elected.They are correct! At-large elections lead to poor representation, lack of transparency, and a board of aldermen that vote unanimously 99.5% of the time. We need to update our election rules in Collierville so that everyone can get fair representation no matter where they live, what they look like, or how much money they make. Hello,
It was Ben Franklin who, when asked what form of government the constitutional convention had produced, said: “A republic, if you can keep it.”
Donald Trump’s election sealed the deal for me to retire after nearly 4 decades in the U.S. Navy. Having been in uniform for every President since Jimmy Carter, I showed my respect for Mr. Trump with my feet. I was done. It was apparent that the next four years would not go well.
Unfortunately, putting himself before his country culminated when Trump and his fellow Republicans planned, cajoled accomplices, then launched a domestic insurrection on the U.S. Capitol. Five lives were lost, and the nation’s innocence, as well. And it ain’t over.
January 6th set a precedent that leadership in a political party will condone political violence. **To this day, GOP members who continue to perpetuate the Big Lie are a direct threat to our democracy.** My opponent, Senator Chuck Grassley, who voted against Trump’s impeachment and tried to block a bipartisan commission from investigating the attack, still has yet to come clean.
The Republican party needs to cull its ranks of the active insurrectionists. Every single person involved in the January 6 attack needs to be held accountable for their actions, including sitting members of Congress who participated in the planning and execution of the insurrection.
**I’m running for the U.S. Senate against Senator Chuck Grassley because I place nation over baseless insurrection. It is a decision not entirely unlike the time of Lincoln. One does not serve the nation in military service to watch idly while it is dismembered by the likes of Donald Trump and his accomplices, to include Chuck Grassley.**
Chuck Grassley is blanketing the state with TV ads attacking me. Mitch McConnell and his Super PACs are spending boatloads more. I’m not taking money from corporate PACs – instead, I’m relying entirely on grassroots donors _like you_.**

Derek, Last year, Senate Republicans filibustered the Freedom to Vote Act. This bill would have strengthened election security and integrity, making it easier to register and harder for dark money to find its way into our politics. The truth is, if we fail to keep the House and Senate blue next month, we’re going to face even more of this partisan obstructionism. The right to vote is fundamental, and it’s just one of many things that the election this November is about. body:
Have you considered the order you'll withdraw your retirement income?
# **The Best Way to Withdraw From Your Retirement Accounts**
**Have you considered the order you'll withdraw your retirement income? Doing so in the incorrect order could cost you hundreds of thousands of dollars.**
Choosing a financial advisor can be a major life decision. While you can't predict the future, a financial advisor can [**help you plan**](http://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=fc4e6159e67b4705aacd63f231f90acb&_e=V996arPTb8ifPvbPoBXIUvBLHcEvm4pVZTVx6OXF1HfCdSeeIbAx3Zpp01OAPozCxR-W84d1iW7-1Wkau_sjsU2MPnQV7yaTjhRAw-K6aqgZjezHlZNCFn_DD2a9euSasDshSxljUOoOlI6okvNpy1H2nL8anFF2a7KYCYWWX7lJeFgNrhqwgIR92gqNHf-o5AzY66tp1Qxz5deR5bieqMDHtn7Zm7pIOfxn1PfeAlKDbT7boI-PMI5riTYk1dDIQikethHU_GAJ7hmk13CzPJGVRXmkZ35Eqwb-yGNMqS0j-I0joaRBWGEwMjDt_WBRbLTJWYAeoGmIkpHwbHZw7Pve4Md7Wd1T5t-IkGesVRFNC4VuCAc0gg_FMfNqkWnDlq-AuxA5GfuSciRFN2TkemRs0dp0sG5dDL4BUzfHFzw%3D) ahead.
A 2020 Northwestern Mutual study found that 71% of U.S. adults admit their financial planning needs improvement. However, only 29% of Americans work with a financial advisor.1
The value of working with a financial advisor varies by person and advisors are legally prohibited from promising returns, but research suggests people who [**work with a financial advisor**](http://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=fc4e6159e67b4705aacd63f231f90acb&_e=V996arPTb8ifPvbPoBXIUvBLHcEvm4pVZTVx6OXF1HfCdSeeIbAx3Zpp01OAPozCxR-W84d1iW7-1Wkau_sjsU2MPnQV7yaTjhRAw-K6aqgZjezHlZNCFn_DD2a9euSasDshSxljUOoOlI6okvNpy1H2nL8anFF2a7KYCYWWX7lJeFgNrhqwgIR92gqNHf-o5AzY66tp1Qxz5deR5bieqMDHtn7Zm7pIOfxn1PfeAlKDbT7boI-PMI5riTYk1dDIQikethHU_GAJ7hmk13CzPNm4jadEw7zDBL0OhkCFGKG_K4M-7hp39s-pWIx5q2v3JcR1p0P2CRbGViGQZzRCdm5TFkkvjkuJcjPb-80SM-eN3a1MVorynp-d48KnQFr6_2QJjaJVEE8c5UFmKu03vvVyODnsks9_9Z4-UN1cyA8%3D) feel more at ease about their finances and could end up with about 15% more money to spend in retirement.2
A recent Vanguard study found that, on average, a hypothetical $500K investment would grow to over $3.4 million under the care of an advisor over 25 years, whereas the expected value from self-management would be $1.69 million, or 50% less. In other words, an advisor-managed portfolio would average 8% annualized growth over a 25-year period, compared to 5% from a self-managed portfolio.3
[**SmartAsset 's no-cost tool**](http://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=fc4e6159e67b4705aacd63f231f90acb&_e=V996arPTb8ifPvbPoBXIUvBLHcEvm4pVZTVx6OXF1HfCdSeeIbAx3Zpp01OAPozCxR-W84d1iW7-1Wkau_sjsU2MPnQV7yaTjhRAw-K6aqgZjezHlZNCFn_DD2a9euSasDshSxljUOoOlI6okvNpy1H2nL8anFF2a7KYCYWWX7lJeFgNrhqwgIR92gqNHf-o5AzY66tp1Qxz5deR5bieqMDHtn7Zm7pIOfxn1PfeAlKDbT7boI-PMI5riTYk1dDIQikethHU_GAJ7hmk13CzPEU9bZre_QXmNrDOIO36o8QTA2MiNU3TVLcXq7Gj0u6nXvU7Y5eGs7Fa9TOEFHSneajhdJ6zZgAG0O1mYX2EsmbAxrwrJcpBrJiYi_KIw723CqIRguAudiPq0nxBVxZ_H5waqlM_dRpTHJtO1hOFxfI%3D) simplifies the time-consuming process of finding a financial advisor. A short questionnaire helps match you with up to three fiduciary financial advisors each, legally bound to work in your best interest. The whole process takes just a few minutes, and in many cases you can be connected instantly with an advisor for a free retirement consultation.
# **The Best Way to Withdraw From Your Retirement Accounts**
**1\. Start With Your Investment Income**
Withdrawing from your investments first gives your retirement accounts more time to compound interest. If you dive straight into your 401(k) or IRA, you could cost yourself years worth of income in retirement savings.
Whether you have mutual funds, a brokerage account, ETFs, stocks or bonds, they're all taxable, so you'll have to pay capital gains taxes on withdrawals. Some investments also require you to pay taxes on distributions each year, like some mutual funds. subject: Tough choices
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Fetterman for PA
body:
#
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20221024-1?refcode=em20221024-7855&refcode2=7855_434096_ofruis&akid=7855%2E434096%2Eofruis)
Hi Derek, it’s Martin Sheen.
As President Bartlet in _The West Wing_ , I learned that life — and politics — is full of tough choices. What to do, who to support... and often those choices have real-life consequences.
**But today, I’m reaching out to ask you to make a choice that shouldn’t be tough at all:[Will you join me in supporting John Fetterman’s grassroots campaign for U.S. Senate in Pennsylvania?](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20221024-1?refcode=em20221024-7855&refcode2=7855_434096_ofruis&akid=7855%2E434096%2Eofruis)**
As mayor and lieutenant governor, John has honorably served his community. He’s stood up for the rights extremist Republicans are determined to strip away from the American people, like reproductive freedom, LGBTQ+ equality, and so much more.
John has faced every tough decision head-on. But that hasn’t stopped his Republican opponent, celebrity TV scam artist Dr. Oz, and the MAGA Super PACs behind him from spending millions on nasty attack ads meant to drag John through the mud.
Their unprecedented spending has put this race in a dead heat. Just recently, an election expert _downgraded_ John’s chance of winning Pennsylvania from Leans Democrat to TOSS UP.
We can’t afford to let another dangerous celebrity buy Pennsylvania’s open U.S. Senate seat and jeopardize our Democratic majority. There is a huge difference between celebrity and credibility. **That’s why I need you to join me in supporting John Fetterman today.**
**[Will you add a donation of any amount to John’s campaign today so he can fight back against the flood of GOP money in Pennsylvania and flip this Senate seat on November 8?](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20221024-1?refcode=em20221024-7855&refcode2=7855_434096_ofruis&akid=7855%2E434096%2Eofruis)**
**[Donate Now »](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20221024-1?refcode=em20221024-7855&refcode2=7855_434096_ofruis&akid=7855%2E434096%2Eofruis)**
There’s too much at stake this year to sit on the sidelines. It’s time to come together, elect real leaders like John Fetterman, and finally make some real progress in this country.
Thanks for hearing me out,
Martin Sheen

**[Donate](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-emails?refcode=em20221024-7855-footer&t=1&refcode2=7855_434096_ofruis&akid=7855%2E434096%2Eofruis)**

name: Trudy Busch Valentine
subject: live a life of purpose
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Trudy Busch Valentine for Senate
body:
| | |
---
Peter,

"Live a life of purpose."
I can't count the times I've repeated this to my children – before family gatherings, on the first day of school, at the dinner table. **Above all else, I made sure that my kids were raised with compassionate hearts and the desire to do good by others.**
**But frankly, it seems like far too many of the folks running things in Washington don't have either.** People are pushing their far-right, out-of-touch ideologies instead of actually helping families. They're picking partisan fights instead of putting their heads down and doing the work. And if my opponent, Eric Schmitt, gets to Washington, he'll be just another extremist who's in the Senate to better his own fortunes – not out of any commitment to real service.
I promise you, Peter, that I will be different. If there is one thing that sets our campaign apart from others, it's our commitment to hard work, dedicated service, and real integrity. And I am proud that every member of my team exemplifies these values each day.
Even on long days on RV trips all over Missouri, we make sure to listen to every voter with the same sincerity and focus; we make time to hear their stories; we ask them to share their concerns; and we invite them to be a part of the solutions. Whether you've cast your ballot for red or blue in the past, I am running to work for _your family_ – and you have a place in our movement.
**As senator, I will never forget who I am there to work for. I will serve everyday with the humility and grit that it takes to win your family the meaningful change that you deserve.** I will always lead with kindness, respect, and a listening ear.
**But in order to get there and bring this commitment to Washington, I need your help.[Please, can I count on you to make a donation to help me flip this seat blue and bring respect back to Washington? But frankly, it seems like far too many of the folks running things in Washington don't have either. People are pushing their far-right, out-of-touch ideologies instead of actually helping families. They're picking partisan fights instead of putting their heads down and doing the work. And if my opponent, Eric Schmitt, gets to Washington, he'll be just another extremist who's in the Senate to better his own fortunes – not out of any commitment to real service. I promise you, Peter, that I will be different. If there is one thing that sets our campaign apart from others, it's our commitment to hard work, dedicated service, and real integrity. And I am proud that every member of my team exemplifies these values each day. Even on long days on RV trips all over Missouri, we make sure to listen to every voter with the same sincerity and focus; we make time to hear their stories; we ask them to share their concerns; and we invite them to be a part of the solutions. Whether you've cast your ballot for red or blue in the past, I am running to work for your family – and you have a place in our movement. As senator, I will never forget who I am there to work for. I will serve everyday with the humility and grit that it takes to win your family the meaningful change that you deserve. I will always lead with kindness, respect, and a listening ear. Today is the first day of early voting in South Carolina, which means you can head to the polls starting today through November 5 to vote early in this year's election.

It's time to use your voice to elect strong conservatives up and down the ballot who will help get this country back on track, and I would be honored to have your vote to be a part of the new Republican majority that takes back Congress.

Early voting centers are open Monday, October 24 — Saturday, November 5 (closed Sunday) from 8:30am-6:00pm. Photo ID is required to vote.

body:

Peter,

Would you believe me if I said that a mother watched videos of her daughter having sex with her boyfriend and picked which one her daughter looked best in to **sell?**

Because that's exactly what happened -- Kris Jenner watched AND hand-picked which sex tape her daughter Kim Kardashian would release!

**It is not an exaggeration to say that Hollywood is satanic.**
What could possibly be more satanic than a mother using her daughter's body to sell sex?

If that disgusts you, here's where it gets worse. _It worked_. Kim Kardashian is a billionaire, and she's still selling sex.

She is symbolic of the society we live in today. That if you are willing to degrade yourself, if you're willing to denigrate yourself, then our society will give you more.

**Is this the example we want to leave for our children?**

At BLEXIT, we believe families should be grounded in faith and honor and respect their children and protect their innocence.

My name is Candace Owens, co-founder of the BLEXIT Foundation. BLEXIT focuses on educating minorities about the history of our great country, the principles of the Constitution, and the importance of self-reliance.

I've set a goal to raise $50,000 by the end of the month to show the next generation that they don't have to be like the Kardashians to be successful.

[**Can you support this critical mission with a gift of $25, $35, or even $50? Click here to donate today >>>**](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61722338:Jo2WJgVNP:m:1:3253819041:F93508E1DBA6EBF309181CC631EB97F0:r)

BLEXIT is bringing pro-America, pro-Family values to Black and minority communities through the work of our State Chapters.

Our Chapters spread the universal principles of the BLEXIT movement at the local level through community service, social engagement, educational activities, and virtual events.

They demonstrate how people can escape the mentality of victimhood and empower others to take control of their destinies.

Just this summer, **BLEXIT-Fest in New Jersey introduced our message to over 400 people.** They had a variety of talented performers and speakers and created a memorable community celebration.

**BLEXIT chapter members from our Tampa, FL, and North Charleston, SC sites educated and cared for approximately 80 children** for six weeks during our full-day Summer Camp.

The children in our Tampa program even took a field trip to Legoland!

Now that school has started, these BLEXIT chapters are providing an after-school youth education program - Liberation Camp - for 80 children.

_BLEXIT 's Chapters are a huge part of our Back to School initiative_.

The BLEXIT Illinois Chapter **distributed over 400 school supplies** and BLEXIT merchandise in one of Chicago's most impoverished communities. The NY Chapter was fortunate to **give away 120 school supply kits as well as 40 book bags.**

BLEXIT Chapters are changing the narrative that surrounds America's minority communities.

[**We currently have 42 chapters across the US and more than 14,000 volunteers! You can help BLEXIT support our State Chapters by donating $25, $35, $50, or any other amount today. Click here to send your gift >>>**](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61722338:Jo2WJgVNP:m:1:3253819041:F93508E1DBA6EBF309181CC631EB97F0:r)

BLEXIT is the Black exit from the culture of victimhood, fear, and dependence reinforced by groups that market themselves as serving the Black community, such as Black Lives Matter, but in actuality, they destroy communities.

These organizations are poisoning minority communities. They tell these bright young men and women they are victims of systematic repression and that their skin color is all that defines them.

But here's the ugly truth about other organizations who claim to serve the Black community:

* They claim to support Black communities. . . but they fan the flames of riots and violence that directly impact the lives of the people in those communities.

* They claim to fight for criminal justice reform. . . but they teach Black men and women to hate and disrespect police officers.

* They claim to be a non-profit group fighting for Black men and women. . . but they use donor funds to enrich themselves.

**These other organizations are destroying Black communities, dividing our country, and forcing a message of victimhood and hatred down the throats of minorities.**

BLEXIT is countering their hateful narrative, but we can't do it alone, Peter. Can you donate to BLEXIT today and help us reach our goal of raising $50,000?

| | Friend,

Early Voting is here! Over the next two weeks in Texas, you have the opportunity to head to a polling location to cast your vote in the upcoming Midterm Elections! If you don't know where your closest Early Voting precinct is, [please visit our website here](https://wesleyfortexas.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=724e4968b7cd9603cc2411e9c&id=046cf23875&e=6b59dbf13a). It is imperative that you vote republican all the way down the ballot to ensure we take our country and our county back!

\---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
## **Wesley Hunt and President Trump | Save America Rally

**

Wesley joined President Donald Trump and Lt. Governor Dan Patrick on stage in South Texas on Saturday! Click [here](https://wesleyfortexas.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=724e4968b7cd9603cc2411e9c&id=80447d802c&e=6b59dbf13a) to watch Wesley's remarks! \--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- **Wesley Hunt & Cassy Garcia**

Wesley joined Cassy Garcia in Houston, TX to help raise money for her campaign as she heads into the final stretch against Congressman Henry Cuellar in the Rio Grande Valley! Electing Cassy, Mayra Flores, and Monica De La Cruz to Congress is one of Wesley's top priorities this year! \--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- ** Wesley Hunt: Saving American Energy**

U.S. Congressional Candidate for the Energy Capital of the World, Wesley Hunt, announced that Saving American Energy has surpassed over 1 Million views since its launch in September!
\---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**Wesley Hunt | Houston's Banking Community**

Wesley was honored to attend a luncheon hosted by the International Bank of Commerce to discuss the harmful and overburdensome regulations the Biden Administration has levied upon our financial institutions.
\--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- **Fox and Friends with Wesley Hunt!** [](https://wesleyfortexas.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=724e4968b7cd9603cc2411e9c&id=ba901a468c&e=6b59dbf13a)
Wesley joined Fox and Friends this past week with candidates George Logan and Hung Chao to discuss the work he's doing through Hellfire PAC to elect strong conservative leaders across our country! Listen to Wesley's remarks [here](https://wesleyfortexas.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=724e4968b7cd9603cc2411e9c&id=ade7fca98d&e=6b59dbf13a).
\---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

** Wesley Hunt Meet and Greet**

subject: Why we have to win on November 8

body:

| | | Peter,

I wanted to take a moment to explain why it's so important that Republicans take back control of the Senate in just 15 days. If you get to the end and still think your donation won't make a difference, then I hope you enjoy Nancy Pelosi and Chuck Schumer controlling every aspect of your life.

_Just think what will happen if Democrats expand their control of Congress ... If Chuck Schumer is in power with a Democrat Majority, any radical idea or policy that he and Joe Biden dream up could become the law of the land. We would see drastic cuts to our military, our economy would worsen even further, and China will overtake America as the world's superpower._

Joe Biden has already done enough damage to our nation. We cannot let this continue any longer.

**That 's why I'm fighting so hard to win on November 8th. This election is not about me - it never has been.**
**It 's about keeping our neighborhoods safe.

It's about our economy.

It's about our men and women in uniform.

It's about our future.**

subject: Countdown to Election Day ⏳

body:
The time is now
| |
---
| | | |
---
|
Peter,

There isn't much time left, so I'll make this quick.

Early voting has started in Georgia, and we've already seen record turnout.

If far-Left Democrat Raphael Warnock wins this race again, there will be dire consequences for Georgia and our country. He's bad on crime, bad for our economy, and bad for our schools.

When I'm elected, I'll secure our border, make America energy independent again, defend our police instead of defunding them, cut spending to reduce inflation, and get our country back on track.

**_[I can't do this alone, so I'm asking you to step up today to help me and other strong conservatives win our elections.](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61722461:JkjZPgVNv:m:1:3367311000:EDBF337D68ED589996AA9088C3D2BF12:r "I can’t do this

All eyes are on Georgia. If Republicans win here, Democrats have virtually no chance of holding on to their majority.

The latest polls show Senator Warnock and I are neck and neck, so I know we can win.

This race will come down to the final get-out-the-vote efforts. Every single dollar could impact how many more doors we can knock, phone calls we can make, texts we can send, and voters we can reach.

So can I please count on you to pitch in anything you're able ASAP, even if it's just $35?

Thank you in advance for your generous support.

Heschel Walker

| | | | | Peter, My path to running for U.S. Senate was different than most. I don't come from a wealthy family. I didn't enter this race with a bunch of mega-donors lining up to write big checks to this campaign. My mom was a public school teacher and my dad worked third shift at General Motors. Those jobs were our family's ticket to the middle class. Ever since I was a little kid, my parents taught me never to settle for what is, but to reach for what can be. It was how I graduated high school at the age of 16 and went on to be elected to the Wisconsin State Assembly when I was 25. And it's how I won Wisconsin’s Lieutenant Governor race in 2018 and helped beat Scott Walker. Then, after careful thought and consideration, I decided to get in this U.S. Senate race to defeat Ron Johnson. It was a big decision. I knew that this was going to be one of the most competitive races in the entire country. And it is a race that we must win if we're going to defend and expand the Democratic Senate majority. I was willing to bet that if I decided to run, people like you would come together in large numbers to help fund this campaign. Because the truth is that no single person can flip Wisconsin's Senate seat alone. name: Tom Brejcha
subject: FBI raids pro-lifer's home
body:
I need your immediate support to help the Thomas More Society defend a father-of-seven pro-life advocate against false criminal
And we're defending him in court!

| | | Fellow American, I need your immediate support to help the Thomas More Society defend a father-of-seven pro-life advocate against false criminal charges. Please let me explain. In the early morning of September 23, roughly twenty-five FBI agents wearing tactical gear threatened to break down the door of Mark Houck's home if he didn't let them in immediately. **With guns pointed at Mark, they hauled him off to jail while his wife and kids looked on, screaming.** Now he's facing multiple criminal charges and eleven years in federal prison due to an incident involving an aggressively abusive Planned Parenthood escort – which is why our team is representing him in court. [**Can I count on your best gift of $40 or more to the MARK HOUCK DEFENSE FUND to help us give him the legal defense he deserves?**](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zre4c22dgj79s1l26gnr7qv10fbpad214udh3l7o_rp22sh2s8i66or3cdh61pb4sth2bs) Mark is a dedicated pro-life author, speaker, and sidewalk counselor. He would drive two hours every week to stand outside of abortion clinics for six to eight hours at a time, praying the Rosary and offering support to women who are so desperate they think they have no alternative than to abort their babies, often bringing his twelve-year-old son. But one day, **a Planned Parenthood escort got in his young son's face, ridiculing him and his father in very vulgar and aggressive ways**. Mark defended his son by shoving the escort away after having repeatedly asked him to stop the abuse. The escort wanted him prosecuted for assault and battery for shoving him away from Mark's young son, but the District Court of Philadelphia threw out the case. So, Biden's Department of Justice charged Mark with violating the federal FACE Act...** _and now this courageous pro-life hero faces up to eleven years in federal prison for advocating for life and for defending his family._** We're pulling out all the stops to make sure the DOJ and the abortion clinic escort who are trying to destroy Mark and his family don't get away with this. But this is going to be a long, costly affair, and I need your help. [**That's where your emergency donation to the MARK HOUCK DEFENSE FUND comes in – by giving today you can stand with Mark in his hour of need.**](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zn1e9itcuujiqc4koqonrspp2hq9hijc6f404e20_rp22sh2s8i66or3cdh61pb4sth2bs) Make no mistake, friend, Mark's arrest was a targeted attack specifically intended to intimidate pro-lifers and people of faith. The incident at the abortion clinic was so minor that the authorities refused to press charges and when the escort filed charges himself, his case was thrown out. Fortunately for Mark and his family, if anyone has experience defending pro-life heroes against Biden's DOJ and Planned Parenthood, it's us. My name is Tom Brejcha and I'm the president and chief counsel of the Thomas More Society – the not-for-profit law firm defending Mark Houck. We're proud to have defended many renowned leaders in America's pro-life movement such as Joe Scheidler and the Pro-Life Action League, David Bereit, David Daleiden, Shawn Carney and 40 Days for Life, Abby Johnson, the Susan B. Anthony List, Lila Rose and Live Action, the March for Life, and many more. But without the help of generous donors, none of our crucial work would be possible. Because the reality is, while you can't be the one personally defending Mark in the courtroom, by donating you can help us vindicate this brave father and pro-life hero who is being ground through the system in an unjust prosecution. **[Can I count on your gift of $40, $60, $100, or more to stand with Mark Houck today and fight back against the dark forces of Planned Parenthood?](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zr0fnqi60in6h80l2fr15am7nh6oevmee8ahh4f0_rp22sh2s8i66or3cdh61pb4sth2bs) ** I will be grateful for whatever you're able to send today. Whether it's $10, $40, $60, $250 or more... ...because time is of the essence. We're expecting Mark's defense to cost us hundreds of thousands of dollars. To put it as bluntly as possible, **_Mark could be facing years behind bars for a crime he didn't commit, while his seven children grow up without him and his wife Ryan-Marie is forced to raise their family alone._** Not only that, but pro-life sidewalk counselors across the country may be deterred from going to the clinics out of concern that they, too, could end up in costly legal battles and even face federal charges simply for defending the unborn. So, I do ask that you make your gift as soon as you can. [**Please don't delay in donating to the MARK HOUCK DEFENSE FUND immediately.**](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zns8fuobr9jj4b3emr2c2fptiig1st7eluabecho_rp22sh2s8i66or3cdh61pb4sth2bs)
I've asked my staff to let me know as soon as we get your generous gift so I can let Mark know that you're standing with him. I know Mark and his family will be deeply touched by your generous support. May God bless you,
---

---
Tom Brejcha
President & Chief Counsel

Peter,We've been through so much together this year - not just in politics but as people in general. Things have just been so crazy. The number one thing we learned is that our country can be broken incredibly quickly.We've watched as Joe Biden destroyed **everything** that was built over the previous four years. We've also watched as establishment politicians from **both** parties did so little to stop him in his destructive tirade.Failure is not the end. Those values that led me off the Democrat plantation when I was a Junior in college are the same values that led me to run for office. Those same values lead me now to stay involved in the fight for our country because I know that we need true representation that is not beholden to the establishment on both sides. **We need representatives beholden to the people.** This election will determine whether or not we have a free country left on this earth. It sounds dramatic, but it's true. **America is the last truly free nation on this planet BUT that freedom is fast slipping away. We don't have a Plan B. We MUST fight for the land that we love!**
[](https://breakingconservativedaily.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=22432bec7f541233c6007cfc2&id=5a3281f9b7&e=fdefed58de)
Today, I'm coming to you to announce my PAC "Be Better America". In the last few weeks of this election, I feel it is my duty to try and help strong, America First conservatives win their races and get into positions where they can affect change.Not only for right now, but for the future. This mission to take our country back is not won in one county, one district or one state. It is a nationwide fight that is going to take great patriots from every single corner of our union. **I'm stepping up because it is my duty and I need you to join me, Peter.**[**I'm humbly asking for your most generous contribution in these final critical days of this election cycle. Together, we will defeat the radical globalist agenda.**](https://breakingconservativedaily.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=22432bec7f541233c6007cfc2&id=321eed71dc&e=fdefed58de) It is CRITICAL that patriots from across this country work together to help. Now is the time to come together and WIN!
[](https://breakingconservativedaily.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=22432bec7f541233c6007cfc2&id=baad8e08b7&e=fdefed58de)
I will never back down and I will never give up. Taking back the House and Senate in 2022 is critical. Your support today will help me help the best candidates out there who truly need **every last bit of support** to fight back against the Democrat money machine.Onward to victory,
[](https://breakingconservativedaily.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=22432bec7f541233c6007cfc2&id=fbd6f446d5&e=fdefed58de)

Hello, When Donald Trump was elected, I submitted my request to retire from the U.S. Navy after nearly 4 decades of military service. I never expected I’d one day run for office, but I felt called to continue to serve in whatever way was most meaningful. People told me to prepare myself – to prepare my family – for what lay ahead. They warned me of the nasty attacks, that politics is a ‘blood sport.’ I never thought a Super PAC would run over a million dollars in TV ads attacking me for serving in the U.S. Navy, but that’s exactly what happened. They tried to say that because my military service took me and my family from state-to-state, from country-to-country, that I somehow wasn’t an Iowan anymore. They pretended my upbringing in rural, northwest Iowa never happened. They ignored the sacrifices that my wife, my kids, and my family made in my service. And worst of all, they attacked and denigrated every servicemember and every military family that has to pack up, change schools, say goodbye to friends, and sometimes spend holidays thousands of miles away from each other. Now, I’m taking on an even greater challenge. And in my campaign to defeat Republican Senator Chuck Grassley, things have gotten even nastier, because control of the Senate hinges on our race and whether or not we can turn Iowa blue. [View this message in your browser](https://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2z96ccs69f5956pce692fbhghqib26nljkj4hgimg_rp2ash2s8gb2sbgeppef9t56ej3fctmekp76t1heipnacpne4pqcdtlmui34thgmipnadt4sbp65tb7mgpm8otlc8rmfc36chj6bd1hm9jb3dtgmdjm3cjn6tgefdr6cgpr1cjimcrrfkjge9h6cs5icpoe9cr3cup7cphh62pm9o3mcpj32s5icpge1db3c3gbac9hmkorash1k8gn48n24hhm6or3c9ie8or7c8iv0)

---
Dear Fellow Conservative,

Because I know your time is valuable, and because this issue is vital to national security, I'll get straight to the point:

I'm writing today to invite you to join other conservatives who are pressuring lawmakers to end Biden's open border extremism by completing a simple 1-minute survey using the link below:

**[https://secured.heritage.org/immigration-reform-survey/](https://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2zsnt5bqv4qkc023f5ebk9eheh3mgrde8q8mhhct8_rp22sh2s8i66or3cdh69p33cth2bs)**

It's critical that proactive citizens like you respond to this national poll because despite legacy media's deafening silence on the issue, **this crisis has now reached historic proportions with more than 2 million reported encounters between Border Patrol and illegal immigrants in 2022.**

This is more encounters than ever before in our nation's history--_more than double that of any year during President Donald Trump 's term._

So when people ask me what I think of Biden's immigration policy, I reply: _what immigration policy?_

Beginning the day he took office, Biden's "policies" have created one of the worst humanitarian crises our nation has ever seen.

And now, untold scores of narcotics, violent criminals, and human traffickers are being allowed to flood into American communities, practically unabated, _every single day._

Decades of success advancing conservative policies have taught us that lawmakers in Washington tend to be more responsive when they know that voters are paying attention.

**Will you help us pressure lawmakers to address this urgent matter of national security by completing a brief 1-minute survey on Immigration Reform using the link below?**

**[https://secured.heritage.org/immigration-reform-survey/](https://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2z60giqsqhnfssdq5cl9kbhh92i3iavb6ivbso78g_rp22sh2s8i66or3cdh69p33cth2bs)**

**Armed with your response, we will work on your behalf to turn up the pressure on lawmakers and compel them to act now.**

Let elected officials know loud and clear that **you _demand_ an end to Biden's open border extremism by completing this quick 1-minute survey using the link below:**

**[https://secured.heritage.org/immigration-reform-survey/](https://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2zj3h9ts9tkg84d9ue3elsc6h3c8g4j9m5qdlms1o_rp22sh2s8i66or3cdh69p33cth2bs)**

Thank you,

Andrew P. McIndoe
VP, Development

**P.S.** We must take action now--this issue cannot wait. [**Thank you for joining the fight by completing the 1-minute survey linked here. >>**](https://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2zj9ms3d3mnmf6f1o12i3u5vqrm0etl16qi2oudhg_rp22sh2s8i66or3cdh69p33cth2bs)

| Friend,
I had a BLAST at my first Townhall in Edison- and I'm ready for Round 2!
[Join Me in Carteret for a Townhall on Friday, October 28th](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001s-1mGx6FyJBoOq9A-q1-t3lMADIeN58RRHurq7aCTPVsPaNNKUX5Tx-qXVnu8SM8ACEJvgAh8T9txuwiVudJxsmEi-35KveyNq_oagMM1S4E7HDrjwvr-7461DHrgfSUocOWRtbL1qn6s0NHepvUeA==&c=KqlsgJiQA9HmZ9tHI_zhR8giKWUMiTG2MDltUXNRUohDYibHv9L01Q==&ch=_HYBmjfF3PQtjo-xTO54ODq9OtHp90x_k7o18j7LmiyGoJiwIle1yg==).
Since 1988 (34 l o n g years), Frank Pallone has avoided hearing directly from his constituents. Now that we have a re-drawn 6th District and new neighbors ready for a change in leadership, Frank admits he's running scared.
So scared in fact, that he's called me an "extremist" and a "threat." If I'm a threat to a career politician who is the rubber stamp for an anti-police, anti-security, and anti-America agenda - then I'll take the compliment.
Hey, Friend,.....remember when Hillary and Frank called us "deplorable?" How'd that work out for them?
We elected pro-America patriots like us who, let's be honest, made America a nation of prosperity and freedom-not one beholden to Big Pharma, woke corporations, and China.

Friend, I'm taking heading to Congress to get our country back on track-- and I want YOU to join me in Carteret!

Congress is still on recess and the election is coming up fast. In fact, lots of states are already voting! Use this time to get signed up to poll watch or poll work (in states where you can still sign up), and help us get out the vote in critical states we must win! You can send prewritten text messages to voters or send hand-signed letters (we provide the letter to print out), all from the comfort of your own home. **_Read on for details, and don’t take anything for granted! We must all participate if we are to have any hope of stopping the Democrats’ destruction!_**

**Poll Workers** When we say "poll workers," we mean the people who check voters into the precinct location to vote, hands the voter their ballot or card for the ballot marking device (touch screen computer with ballot), tells the voter where to deposit the ballot in the ballot box, and closes the precinct location after voting is over. Your state may call this position one of the following titles: poll worker, election official, judge of elections, inspector of elections, judge, inspector, or some other similar title. These "poll workers" are generally hired at county level by the permanent employees who administer the elections and maintain voter rolls. Those permanent employees may hold one of the following titles: election supervisor, election board, board of elections, board of commissioners, county supervisors, county judges, etc. The titles vary from state to state. Generally speaking, if you want to work the election on Election Day or during early voting and be paid to work, you will need to reach out the county employee responsible for hiring those poll workers. **Poll Watchers** A poll watcher is the person who is in the voting precinct while voters vote, silently watching and observing the election process. If the poll watcher sees irregularities, the poll watcher will report those irregularities to the entity (i.e., county political party) that assigned the poll watcher position based on the training received by that entity (county political party).

The updated healthcare package was rolled out this month when the Office of Personnel Management announced that through the Federal Employee Health Benefits program, the agency is "pleased to deliver enhanced health benefit offerings" in the form of "[gender affirming](http://lnk.teapartypatriots.-JVoaC6TNMmw) care and services” for transgender and "gender diverse" federal employees. Among the approved providers is the [World Professional Association of Transgender Health (WPATH) Standards of Care](http://lnk.teapartypatriots.--ELFpZEmuw_yw), which infamously [removed minimum age recommendations](http://lnk.teapartypatriots._dXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPTY0NDg3Jm1pZD00NTk3NCZpZD1UMThvOUxuZXVqSGhrOTFRUVEifQ/4kXRIK38lCKWbmuhZ6kJIg) for gender transitions to avoid legal ramifications for medical practitioners involved in the process of providing sex-change therapies and surgeries to minors. The new taxpayer-financed "gender affirming care" move stems from Biden's June 2021 executive order, [Diversity, Equity, Inclusion, and Accessibility in the Federal Workforce](http://lnk.teapartypatriots._bWlkPTQ1OTc0JmlkPVQxOG85TG5ldWpIaGs5MVFRUSJ9/v34xApachurPm4vg11FVsg). It is outrageous that our tax dollars are going towards left-wing, extremist practices like this, and even the use of the phrase, “gender affirming care” is outrageous.

From expanding voting rights, to strengthening our nation’s unions, to addressing the climate crisis, we have been blocked again and again from passing meaningful legislation that would address the long-neglected needs of working people in this country. In a time where the ultra-rich are only growing richer, working people are falling further behind and are losing even more support from their elected representatives. It’s a status quo we can’t allow to continue. **That’s why I’m writing to you about Pennsylvania’s U.S. Senate race.** Not only do we have a real chance to elect a leader like John Fetterman who will take on powerful special interests — this race is one of our best opportunities to flip a seat, expand our Senate majority, and finally show the American people a government that works for them instead of the wealthiest few. In order to elect John and flip this seat, we need to come together and show as much support as possible in these critical final weeks. So I am asking you: **[Will you please split a donation of $5 right now between John Fetterman's campaign for U.S. Senate and Kirsten Gillibrand? John Fetterman is a different kind of Democrat. He supported legalizing marijuana before it was popular, officiated a same-sex marriage before it was legal, and pushed for universal healthcare long before it was mainstream. If elected to the Senate, we don’t have to wonder where John will stand. He will take on corporate greed, make the wealthy pay their fair share in taxes, and fight for the working class of this country — not the rich and powerful. But right now, within our corrupt campaign finance system, John is up against tens of millions of dollars from right-wing super PACs that are running grossly dishonest attack ads trying to defeat him. We cannot allow these billionaire-funded super PACs to succeed, which is why I’m asking again: **[Please split a donation of any amount between John Fetterman and Kirsten Gillibrand today to ensure we can take on the GOP super PACs pumping dark money into Pennsylvania and flip this seat this November.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/53224988/374821283/-1087018250?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk3697-bu-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTkvMS83MjcyMiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhZThmZjY1NS1jMTUzLWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThlMDgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Fp4iT1Cmew3atslkRuyJlJ7KcADhQbAUOPZ9EjUkLzs=)** Anything you’re able to contribute today will help ensure we have a crucial vote in the Senate to pass legislation that could transform this country. body:

| | Dear fellow American,
Asked by a reporter in 1860 how he had acquired his extraordinary rhetorical skills, Abraham Lincoln credited his study of Euclid.
While studying law in Springfield, Lincoln explained, he became convinced that the ability to demonstrate the truth of things was essential to the good practice of law.
Consequently, Lincoln left his job, retired to his father’s cabin, and did not return until he could “give any proposition in the six books of Euclid at sight.”
By studying Euclid, we improve our ability to reason soundly—plus, in my experience, the study of Euclid can be great fun.
That’s why Hillsdale College has produced a free online course on the topic **“Mathematics and Logic: From Euclid to Modern Geometry.”**
Through**“Mathematics and Logic: From Euclid to Modern Geometry,”** you will learn the importance of deductive reasoning as a foundation for pursuing knowledge in all fields of learning, as well as in everyday life.
---
| | **Now, the course is available in a beautiful DVD box set for viewing in your home or for use in a small group.** **** **You can receive the DVD box set as a thank-you for your tax-deductible gift of $100 or more in support of our educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty.**
Your tax-deductible gift will help promote our free online courses and other educational outreach efforts in this critical time for our nation. And your gift matters even more because...
Hillsdale accomplishes all its work while refusing to accept ONE PENNY of government funding—not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans.
---
| [](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2znrl746o3fdn1hdqp4a8eovi3pakcmim8shstmt8_rp22sh2s8i66or3cdj6cpj1c1h2bs)
---
| | That’s why we need the support of friends like you, who understand the importance of education to liberty.
Quantities of this special DVD box set are limited, so reserve your copy today. I’ve included a secure link for you to make your tax-deductible gift below:
[_**https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/dvd-mathematics-and-logic-course**_](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z16q43lgha88ro7b81malq3ckhqdgflbf0o3i6bo_rp22sh2s8i66or3cdj6cpj1c1h2bs)

Warm regards,
Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

name: Harmeet Dhillon
subject: You can't be trusted..
body:
| | | Peter, Imagine that you've just been called into the middle school principal's office to have a "serious talk" about your daughter. You're worried -- is it her grades? Her behavior? Is she hurt? Instead, the principal tells you that your daughter -- your 12- year-old little girl -- is now your son. That behind your back, the school has been "educating" your preteen daughter \-- for months, in total secret -- about how to "transition" her gender. And they instructed her to keep it hidden from you...because you "can't be trusted." That you, her parent, are not "safe." But now, she has a new name. New pronouns. A new bathroom. And you just need to accept it. _Wouldn 't you be furious?_ I know I would be! So it's no surprise that's exactly how Jessica Konen felt when she was called into her daughter's California middle school and this nightmare played out in real life. **Now, Jessica is fighting back and suing the school district -- plus the principal and the two teachers who "groomed" her daughter -- and she needs your help to win justice in a court of law. ** [**Will you please make an urgent, tax-deductible donation to the Center for American Liberty and help us fund this lawsuit while generating a nationwide wave of support for Jessica and her daughter?**](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61723866:6u2y9gVNN:m:1:3371812801:0BFC54515EF498CB39DB4CB1C2A71DA6:r) I hope you will, because as infuriating as that story is, the details are even more outrageous. Would you believe Jessica's daughter was just eleven when she was lured by these teachers to join their so-called "Equality Club"? **_They first convinced this little girl that she was bisexual. Then, as they sunk their hooks deeper, they told her -- not long after her twelfth birthday -- that really, she was probably "transgender." _** "But don't tell your parents!" they warned. In fact, they operated the entire club under a cloak of secrecy. No permission slips were signed. No attendance was taken. No membership lists were kept. Meetings were scheduled for lunchtime -- instead of after school, like other clubs -- so parents wouldn't begin to wonder where their kids were. What were they hiding?? If you've followed the growing nationwide problem of teachers "grooming" young, confused students -- you probably know some of the predatory tactics these teachers often use to manipulate vulnerable children into believing they're "transgender" or "non-binary." This case was no exception. In fact, these two teachers even let some of their secrets slip on leaked audio from a Teachers Association conference! Discussing how they managed to target so many new recruits for their club, one of the teachers confessed: "We totally stalked what they were doing on Google." **These teachers zeroed in on confused and troubled students and -- instead of helping them -- they further filled these children 's heads with lies and more confusion. ** [**Which is why I 'm asking you to make an urgent donation of $35 or more today if you agree with our lawsuit against these teachers, the principal, and the Spreckels Union School District.**](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61723866:6u2y9gVNN:m:1:3371812801:0BFC54515EF498CB39DB4CB1C2A71DA6:r) My name is Harmeet Dhillon. I'm a lawyer, and the founder of the Center for American Liberty. You may recognize me from one of my many Fox News appearances with Jessica Konen or other plaintiffs my nonprofit organization is representing in lawsuits against government officials who violate Americans' rights. Today, I'm asking you to join us in support of Jessica's case. It's clear that the defendants deprived Jessica Konen of her civil rights as a parent, that they conspired to do so, and that they inflicted emotional distress on both Jessica and her daughter. Those legal claims and more are at the heart of our lawsuit. I believe our evidence lays out a very strong case. But you must remember, this is a California school district and the defense's case will be funded by the government. And it will pay whatever it takes to defend leftist ideologies. [**That 's why, I hope you'll also consider making a generous donation of $25, $35, $50 or $100 to help fund our case. **](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61723866:6u2y9gVNN:m:1:3371812801:0BFC54515EF498CB39DB4CB1C2A71DA6:r) The Center for American Liberty is a nonprofit organization, meaning we receive no government funding -- _unlike the deep-pocketed defendants in most of our cases._ Because of this, we rely on support from generous Americans who can recognize an injustice and want to see it set right. Our nonprofit status also means your donation is tax-deductible to the fullest extent allowed by law. We've seen evidence of this type of "grooming" at schools across the country. And it's not just in places like California! Dangerous teachers like this are unfortunately in classrooms across the country. Thankfully, the tide seems to be turning against them. Earlier this year, Governor DeSantis outlawed teachers from having these sexualized conversations with their young students. And elsewhere, parents have gotten involved with their local school boards to run for office and change policies that have put radical gender ideology ahead of student safety or parental rights. Those are political solutions. **Ours is a legal one.** And I believe that, in order to fully purge this predatory behavior from our schools, we need to fight this battle on all available fronts. Won't you please help us win this fight in a court of law?**[Join the fight with a generous donation of $35 or more so the courts, the plaintiffs, the defendants -- everybody -- will know how big the nationwide movement to protect kids has grown. ](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61723866:6u2y9gVNN:m:1:3371812801:0BFC54515EF498CB39DB4CB1C2A71DA6:r)** ** ** No parent should have to endure what Jessica Konen and her daughter did, and it's up to us to use the full force of the law to make sure no teacher is allowed to get away with this again. Thank you,

Thank you!](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61723866:6u2y9gVNN:m:1:3371812801:0BFC54515EF498CB39DB4CB1C2A71DA6:r) **

body:

Peter, my name's Derrick Van Orden.
I'm a Christian, Trump-endorsed Navy SEAL running for Congress in the great state of Wisconsin.
[**I know my good friend Senator Ron Johnson reached out to you -- but you never answered his call for help on the eve of our biggest fundraising deadline to date... and we fell $9,937.19 short.**](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61723883:6UDa9gVhN:m:1:3372944669:8C54009CE73A0ABB1C1311A2AAFC1221:r)

**[EXTENDED DEADLINE: 5X-MATCH FOR YOU >>>](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61723883:6UDa9gVhN:m:1:3372944669:8C54009CE73A0ABB1C1311A2AAFC1221:r)**
Ron Johnson and I share some things in common:
We've never backed down from a fight with the far-Left, we're proud Conservatives, and we're both running in the #1 battleground state in the country.
**So why are we both reaching out to you?** _Because if we miss this extended fundraising deadline, our plans for victory will completely FALL APART._
[**We 're already behind but if we can close the gap before 5X-matching expires AT MIDNIGHT, I know we can turn things around. Peter, our extended deadline is about to hit so time is of the essence.**](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61723883:6UDa9gVhN:m:1:3372944669:8C54009CE73A0ABB1C1311A2AAFC1221:r)
**[EXTENDED DEADLINE: 5X-MATCH FOR YOU >>>](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61723883:6UDa9gVhN:m:1:3372944669:8C54009CE73A0ABB1C1311A2AAFC1221:r)**

Retired Navy SEAL
Derrick Van Orden
_**\-------------- Forwarded Message --------------
Subject: Folks -
Sender: Ron Johnson (WI-R)**_
Peter -- this is Senator Ron Johnson.
I have a lot to tell you and there's not a lot of time. I'll make this quick:
* Wisconsin is the #1 battleground state in America for the House AND Senate
* My race is shaping up to be one of the most expensive races in history
* September 30th will be the single biggest fundraising deadline we've EVER faced

I'd be preaching to the choir if I told you how important the next election is. Our economy is in shambles... Democrats are trying to IMPEACH Justice Clarence Thomas... 2 million illegals crossed our border under Joe Biden's watch... Liberals just rammed through a huge Green-New-Deal-style climate bill... and now Biden wants to force American taxpayers like you to foot the bill for student loan debt.
**It 's 100% clear: this is a socialist takeover of America. And we are running out of time to stop them.**
I'm also teaming up with Republican Whip Steve Scalise -- FOR THE FIRST TIME EVER -- because we can't take back our country without taking back the House. [**That 's why I'm rushing to you in the final hours before our September 30 deadline to ask for your help.**](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61723883:6UDa9gVhN:m:1:3372944669:8C54009CE73A0ABB1C1311A2AAFC1221:r)
I'm even told that for every $1 you're willing to contribute by midnight tonight will be matched with $5 thanks to a group of anonymous donors. _Please hurry -- everything rides on this deadline!_
**[Contribute $25 Now ($125 Impact)](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61723884:6UDa9gVhN:m:1:3372944669:8C54009CE73A0ABB1C1311A2AAFC1221:r)**
**[Contribute $35 Now ($175 Impact)](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61723883:6UDa9gVhN:m:1:3372944669:8C54009CE73A0ABB1C1311A2AAFC1221:r)**
**[Contribute $50 Now ($250 Impact)](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61723885:6UDa9gVhN:m:1:3372944669:8C54009CE73A0ABB1C1311A2AAFC1221:r)**
**[Contribute $100 Now ($500 Impact)](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61723886:6UDa9gVhN:m:1:3372944669:8C54009CE73A0ABB1C1311A2AAFC1221:r)**
The Democrats know that their ENTIRE socialist agenda depends on winning battleground states like Wisconsin.
That's why Liberal groups are unleashing $50,000,000+ to defeat me and other Republicans in my home state of Wisconsin. If we miss our September 30th, it will be impossible to hold the line here. [**In other words: WE NEED YOUR HELP RIGHT NOW!**](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61723883:6UDa9gVhN:m:1:3372944669:8C54009CE73A0ABB1C1311A2AAFC1221:r)
Time is short so I'll wrap this up. Our deadline is here. We're behind. But you can save us with a 500% matched contribution today.
Thank you,
Senator Ron Johnson (R-WI)
* * *
[](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61723887:6UDa9gVhN:m:1:3372944669:8C54009CE73A0ABB1C1311A2AAFC1221:r)
Can you keep this between us? Pollsters, pundits, and the media are saying the unthinkable -- _Pelosi and the Democrats have a chance to defeat us. And with hundreds of millions of dollars in their war chest to spend attacking us -- they 're going ALL IN._
We'll say it straight: we're being outraised. And if we sit here and do nothing, Pelosi and the Democrats will buy this election from under us. [**If you 've been waiting to step up, now is the time. Everything President Trump worked so hard to build -- our Conservative Supreme Court Majority, a secure border, a booming economy, HIS ENTIRE LEGACY -- is on the line.**](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61723887:6UDa9gVhN:m:1:3372944669:8C54009CE73A0ABB1C1311A2AAFC1221:r)
We still have time to turn things around, but we need to act fast. Whether we win or lose will come down to what you do in this moment.
\-- Steve Scalise, House Republican Whip
