Friend,

The RAID on my Mar-a-Lago home was nothing more than unhinged POLITICAL PERSECUTION against ME, YOUR President.

_ For six straight years, I've been **harassed, investigated, defamed, slandered, and persecuted** like no one in American history-- yet all I have ever wanted, and all we have ever fought for, is to simply __**MAKE AMERICA GREAT AGAIN.**_

I won't stop fighting - not when the Left is coming after me like never before - but I could use the input of my most trusted supporters, like YOU, Friend.

**[DO YOU AGREE THE PEOPLE BEHIND THIS WITCH HUNT SHOULD BE HELD ACCOUNTABLE?](https://link.nucleusemail.com/f/a/bQs96YoZ2AJvk-Jax_f88Q~~/AATY9gE~/RgRlN8__N1FedSFGRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tWAQAAAAA)**

**[YES>>](https://link.nucleusemail.com/f/a/a-1TcYQnEZohvW98LyGdnQ~~/AATY9gE~/RgRlN8__N1FedSFGRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tWAQAAAAA)**

**[NO>>](https://link.nucleusemail.com/f/a/zXjVnD_je7O19OjHx5F2sw~~/AATY9gE~/RgRlN8__N1FedSFGRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tWAQAAAAA)**

_The people behind these savage witch hunts have no shame, no morals, no conscience, and absolutely no respect for the citizens of this country._

Everyone associated with this travesty will go down in history as _**scoundrels and arsonists**_ who tried to demolish our justice system, shatter our most sacred traditions, and wipe out the very foundations of our democracy - _for their own selfish partisan gain._

Friend, I’m sure you get a ton of these emails, and you don’t love them. So let me be straightforward with you: I don’t in any way enjoy asking for money. I’m a single mother and I know firsthand what it’s like to live paycheck to paycheck. I’ve worked hard for every dollar to my name. But running a grassroots campaign means we can’t just go to a few wealthy donors for fundraising. We’re working to show that campaigns don’t need to appeal to the rich and powerful in order to fundraise. For this cycle we need a large base of small donors to fund our campaign. A major reason I decided to run for Congress is because I’m tired of politicians who serve a few special interests over their own constituents. Politicians in both parties often spend more time with rich donors than everyday Americans. Their actions show that it matters how you raise money. It’s a lot easier to just go to a few rich people to fund a campaign, but we must do the hard work of building a campaign for the masses. We need your help defeating Byron Donalds now. name: Josh Harder
subject: reflecting on my opponent's comments
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Harder for Congress |
body:
Peter,

A few days ago my opponent Tom Patti called himself the “Antichrist to the leftist agenda” because he’s a “white Christian heterosexual male.”

I’ve had some time to reflect on why these comments hit me so hard and I wanted to share my thoughts.

I love my home here in the Valley. We’re a wonderful diverse community that looks out for each other. People are much more likely to ask me in the grocery story about Lillian than they are anything political. Politics doesn’t divide us like it does in some other communities.

And that’s why it’s so hurtful my opponent uses this kind of rhetoric.

It only takes one person with a large microphone to change how people view themselves and their community. It seeps into our psyches and turns neighbor against neighbor.

All this is to say, this campaign isn’t just about policy differences. Or even which party controls Congress. This race, to me, is about saving what makes my home feel like home. And I’d argue this rhetoric over time will also come for our country too. Maybe it already has.

If you believe we need to cut this destructive rhetoric off at its roots, I hope you’ll consider chipping into my race. We have 20 days left.

| Peter,

It all comes down to me.

The Senate. America. Our children's future. Everything is riding on my race against John Fetterman.

I'm not afraid of this fight. I would never have jumped in this race if I wasn't ready for such a huge responsibility.

But I can't afford to be shy with so much on the line. So I'll just come right out and ask: **_[Can I count on you to dig deep and chip in whatever you can to help me win?](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61724093:Jv_lXgVhN:m:1:3368395361:7695B55CD66E9A6C527A279A971DF7C7:r "Can I count on you to dig deep and chip in whatever you can to help me win?")_**

John Fetterman simply cannot be allowed in Congress. His priorities will crush American families and put our communities at risk.

**He has pushed to free convicted murderers amid a massive spike in violent crime, and he 's committed to growing America's bloated and expensive bureaucracy.**

Fetterman's agenda will devastate our country, Peter. But he's still polling just ahead of me, thanks to his MASSIVE cash advantage.

We're now less than **15 days** from Election Day and this race is shaping up to be one of the most expensive in history. **My opponent raised over $5.5 MILLION in August from fundraising emails just like this.**

_**[That's why I'm coming to you and asking for a donation of any amount to supercharge my campaign and wash away Fetterman's cash advantage.](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61724093:Jv_lXgVhN:m:1:3368395361:7695B55CD66E9A6C527A279A971DF7C7:r "That’s why I’m coming to you and asking for a donation of any amount to supercharge my
campaign and wash away Fetterman’s cash advantage.")**_

I'm ready to face down my opponent's massive political machine by myself, Peter. But it would really help if I had you on my side.

Thank you for your generous support,
Dr. Oz

name: Blake Masters
subject: I want you to know why I’m running to take back Arizona
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Blake Masters for Senate**
body:
I wanted to reach out personally | I know you've heard a lot from my campaign lately, but with only a few weeks left until the Election...

[](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61724048:JD17XgVPN:m:1:3359512271:40BDACAD84FA2226C986A5D4BFED9E4C:r)

Peter,

Do you have a minute?

I know you've heard a lot from my campaign lately, but with only a few weeks left until the Election, I wanted to take the time to reach out personally.

Let me start by telling you about myself and why I felt compelled to run for Senate: Arizona has helped shape my life for the better \- and I owe this state so much. I grew up here and am proud to still call Arizona home, along with my incredible wife Catherine and our three boys.

[](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61724048:JD17XgVPN:m:1:3359512271:40BDACAD84FA2226C986A5D4BFED9E4C:r)

That's why it's so deeply troubling to see what the failed leadership of the Biden administration and my opponent, Mark Kelly, have done to our nation.

Whether it is _**dangerous criminals**_ pouring across our unsecured border, _**crushing inflation**_ that is killing family-owned businesses, or _**teaching toxic ideologies**_ to our children, Democrats are destroying the America we know and love.

This country deserves so much better, **and I 'm running to create a more prosperous future for ALL Americans.**

[](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61724048:JD17XgVPN:m:1:3359512271:40BDACAD84FA2226C986A5D4BFED9E4C:r)

**[HELP DELIVER A BETTER FUTURE FOR ARIZONA AND AMERICA.>>](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61724048:JD17XgVPN:m:1:3359512271:40BDACAD84FA2226C986A5D4BFED9E4C:r)**

I know what it takes to tackle difficult problems and build success from scratch. I'm an America First outsider who has spent my career in the private sector creating jobs and investing in our youth. I'm committed to bringing YOUR voice to Washington _**and won 't EVER back down from fighting to put America First.**_

Let me be absolutely clear - _I 'm not interested in the political games of Washington._ I'm running for Senate because decent, hard-working people like **YOU** deserve solutions to the problems you face on a daily basis.

[](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61724048:JD17XgVPN:m:1:3359512271:40BDACAD84FA2226C986A5D4BFED9E4C:r)

We all know what is at stake on November 8th: The future of our state, our country, and control of the Senate. It is beyond critical that we restore **competent, conservative leadership** in Washington.

My race is extremely close and will be decided in this campaign's final days and weeks. I'm confident that united, we WILL win this election for the America First movement and begin building a better future for our nation. I'd be honored to have your support in this critical fight.

**[PLEASE CHIP IN ANY AMOUNT YOU CAN TO HELP US WIN THIS ELECTION FOR THE AMERICA FIRST MOVEMENT.>>](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61724048:JD17XgVPN:m:1:3359512271:40BDACAD84FA2226C986A5D4BFED9E4C:r)**

Thank you,

Blake Masters
U.S. Senate Candidate from Arizona

**[CONTRIBUTE NOW>>](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61724048:JD17XgVPN:m:1:3359512271:40BDACAD84FA2226C986A5D4BFED9E4C:r)**

Being raised by two working parents who sometimes struggled to make ends meet wasn’t always easy.
Flying combat missions in Desert Storm wasn’t easy.
Watching Gabby fight so hard in the early days, weeks, and months of her recovery wasn’t easy.
Running for the U.S. Senate and having Donald Trump and National Republicans relentlessly attack me personally — that hasn’t been easy either.
But as a kid, I had my brother Scott.
In combat, I had my wingmen.
With Gabby, we had our whole community offering support.
And in these campaigns, I have you.

clean_body: | Friend, Let me introduce myself ... My name is Nick LaLota. I am the Republican nominee for Congress for New York 's 1st Congressional District. Service has always been an important part of my life, and while I'm working hard to win on Long Island, I'm going to need some backup from strong conservative fighters elected to Congress who value Service Above Self. That 's why it is so important that we reelect my friend Jim Banks to Congress in the great state of Indiana. | He and I share many similar experiences. A member of the Navy, Jim Banks served in the Afghanistan War and served as a Supply Corps Officer. Before his service, he got involved in local politics in the Indiana State Senate, bringing his patriotism and love for America with him. Friend, we need more servicemembers in Congress who have the same love of country that Jim does. From inflation, to border security, to education, government accountability and every issue in between, Indiana deserves a voice like Jim 's in Washington. While I'm busy with my own campaign, I need your help to make sure that Jim is prepared to fight back against the Democrat attacks coming from Pelosi. Thank you for your support -- we've got a nation to save! Derek — I wanted to talk to you today about why it’s absolutely critical that you take action in this race.
Pennsylvania is one of the biggest swing states in the country. And the next Governor will have the power to make decisions on issues that affect us all — like abortion access, voting rights, job opportunities, rising costs, and more.
The Governor will also have the power to protect our democracy. They’ll be able to appoint a Secretary of State who will oversee the 2024 presidential election — and they’ll be able to make sure people’s votes count, instead of conspiracy theories and the Big Lie winning out.

While the GOP has ignored this crisis because it benefits from landlords and wealthy developers, Democrats are constantly fighting for you. Just last week, Democratic nominee for GA House District 120, Mokah Jasmine Johnson, held a community gathering calling attention to the housing crisis in Athens.

While the GOP criminalizes poverty and homelessness, Georgia Democrats are attacking the root of the problem in the housing crisis.

**Johnson addressed the city’s rising homelessness rate calling to end the statewide ban on rent control and provide relief for rent-burdened community members.** The power of state lawmakers to tie the hands of local governments only makes it more urgent that we flip the State House and Governor’s office so we can get to work bringing relief to those most affected by the housing crisis.

**I ended up losing that extremely competitive race and it wasn’t until 18 years later that I finally won my race for Congress in 2012.**

clean_body: But in the face of discriminatory attacks, I didn’t give up. | = Peter, I want to be vulnerable with you for a moment and share my personal painful story about my coming out experience. In 1994, my Republican opponent outed me as gay with bigoted and homophobic ads to our district. I hadn’t even come out publicly yet! For members of the LGBTQ+ community, coming out is an extremely personal and sensitive moment. So, you can imagine my horror and heartbreak upon finding out I had been outed so publicly in such a hateful way. I was crushed. I ended up losing that extremely competitive race and it wasn’t until 18 years later that I finally won my race for Congress in 2012. Peter, I’m so glad that in the face of such discriminatory attacks, I didn’t give up. Now, I can fight for LGBTQ+ equality and dignity in our nation’s capital and stand up for other marginalized Americans. But sadly, since 2012, Republican bigotry and vitriol has not slowed down. **MEET MIKE:** | A CHAMPION FOR PRINCIPLED LEADERSHIP

Mike learned his love for the Constitution around the family dinner table. Mike's father, Rex Lee, served as Solicitor General under President Ronald Reagan and later as President of Brigham Young University. As a child, Mike attended his father's arguments before the U.S. Supreme Court, giving him a unique understanding of the government from an early age. As an attorney he developed a more complete understanding of why the Constitution is essential to the protection of life, liberty, and property.

After graduating from law school in 1997, he served as a law clerk to Judge Dee Benson of the U.S. District Court for the District of Utah. He then clerked for Judge Samuel A. Alito, Jr., who was serving at that time on the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Third Circuit Court in Newark, New Jersey. After his second clerkship, he joined the Washington, D.C. office of Sidley & Austin, where he specialized in appellate and Supreme Court litigation. Several years later, Mike was invited to serve as an Assistant U.S. Attorney in Salt Lake City, preparing briefs and arguing cases before the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Tenth Circuit. He served as Governor Huntsman's General Counsel and then went to Washington for a one-year clerkship with Justice Alito at the U.S. Supreme Court.

Following his clerkship, Mike joined the Salt Lake office of the Washington, D.C.-based law firm of Howrey LLP. Mike has earned a reputation as an outstanding lawyer based on his sound judgment, writing and courtroom advocacy skills, and thorough understanding of the Constitution. Mike and Sharon have three children and live in Provo, Utah.

subject: Encouraging News!
body:
HEY TEAM GEELS!
Five days into this and we've had encouraging news from our volunteers working at the polls. Courtney has worked VERY HARD at swaying the Democrats votes. Minds have been changed, some Democrats are voting for her, engaging conversations are taking place, "I met her last week", "she came to my house", thumbs up, winks, "I voted for her", "someone was just telling me about her", etc.

That being said, there are still MANY out there who haven't heard of her or just saw her signs but don't know her positions. Courtney has a chance to WIN but it will be close! Getting a card into the hands of voters is very effective. Remember, we saw that it moved the percentage toward Courtney between 3-5% points at every place we had someone standing at the primaries. We need you!

Here is a visual of the open shifts for each county. Please check your calendars to see if you can plug in somewhere. It doesn't have to be the exact hours you see. We will take any hours you can give us. There are even 1/2 hour shifts open. Please consider going to any county you feel comfortable in. Let's do this! Email, text or call _me or your county coordinator_ to be scheduled!

name: Dr. Ben Carson
subject: I rarely do this
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Marco Rubio for Senate
body:
I really don’t reach out often, which is how you know this is critically important.

|
---
| | | | [](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2zc05t3nhirnmd00eihokhp6pep09oraav9cfadjg_rp22sh2s8i66or3cdgm0or0clh2bs "Ben Carson headshot")
---

I really don't reach out often, which is how you know this is critically important. I'll be short, though.

Here are the facts:
1. Marco Rubio has been outraised SIX Quarters in a row.
2. Marco's opponent, Val Demings, is financially backed by Nancy Pelosi and Chuck Schumer.
3. Poll after poll after poll shows his race is tied.
4. The media is saying Marco's in the fight of his career, and he's never seen a race as tough as this.
5. His opponent has spent over $47 million spreading lies about him, and Marco can't keep up.
6. If Marco loses, we will not be able to take back the Senate and get our country back.

---
| | | [DEFEND MARCO RUBIO >>](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2zg8bilh3h6cqfp5e0chbvocbqm9uitave1auls4o_rp22sh2s8i66or3cdgm0or0clh2bs "DEFEND MARCO RUBIO")
---
**[If you can spare $16, $24, or even $45, it will make all the difference in this tied race.](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2zkehfs2mc566mjb16rb6v7ir88dqi3llbjuk83to_rp22sh2s8i66or3cdgm0or0clh2bs "If you can spare $16, $24, or even $45, it will make all the difference in this tied race.")**
---
| | | [LET'S SAVE AMERICA TOGETHER >>](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2zjn4blh0d21eumh9hn08u6ramlu57aj49ksi5gs0_rp22sh2s8i66or3cdgm0or0clh2bs "LET’S SAVE AMERICA TOGETHER")
---
Before I got into politics, I thought you had to write big checks to make a difference. But now, let me tell you, any dollar can make a difference in a race like this that's tied. If you're staying on the sidelines because you think you don't matter, that's just not true!

__You__ have the power to decide what happens next. __You have two choices__ :
1. Accept that the Democrats have won, and we can't get our country back on track.
2. **[We can work together to save our country and take back control from the Democrats](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2z8l45012im9pn7qh726338ovv3r7ijo4kugmp2po_rp22sh2s8i66or3cdgm0or0clh2bs "We can work together to save our country and take back control from the Democrats").**

---
| | | [JOIN THE TEAM THAT SAVES AMERICA >>](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2z8vs1k1o7nhrb4tgtdfuamlsurek5j651h1ru67o_rp22sh2s8i66or3cdgm0or0clh2bs "JOIN THE TEAM THAT SAVES AMERICA")
---
If you don't donate because you think it doesn't matter, I really hope you reconsider. If you can't donate because you can't afford to, know that I understand, and I appreciate you taking the time to read this.

I appreciate you,
Dr. Ben Carson
---
| | | | |

* * *
---
[](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2zidfcortfso0cff3vli9acgfnnoje9unqucud1bo_rp22sh2s8i66or3cdgm0or0clh2bs "First, Democrats gained more momentum than ever after Roe v. Wade, raising a record-shattering $80M. Then, Nancy Pelosi launched a major nationwide fundraising operation to defeat Marco Rubio. Now, Marco's falling millions of dollars behind Nancy Pelosi.") This is no joke. **My opponent already votes with Nancy Pelosi 100% of the time,** and now that they are actively campaigning together, I'm starting to get nervous.

I'm starting to get nervous because I am one of the most vulnerable Republicans up for re-election this November and Pelosi knows that if the Dems defeat me, they will have full access to pass their liberal agenda.

**The Filibuster will be abolished.

Speech will be censored.**

**And conservatives will be silenced.**
| | [HELP MARCO DEFEAT PELOSI >>](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2zquiv26b6hi50no8hg96usdgjm2nsl0v16dh64j8_rp22sh2s8i66or3cdgm0or0clh2bs "Help Marco Defeat Pelosi")
---

What you decide to do in the next 30 seconds could very well change the course of American history. If I lose, it will be a nightmare for conservative values.

**[So please, can you chip in $5 to help me fight back against Pelosi, the entire Democrat establishment, and their new MASSIVE warchest of cash?](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2z8du24oagomacg68dumdfnp0rfuj3g5f6dgql4p0_rp22sh2s8i66or3cdgm0or0clh2bs "So please, can you chip in $5 to help me fight back against Pelosi, the entire Democrat establishment, and their new MASSIVE warchest of cash?")**
| | | [](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2zhvo7gjeg6418ao15jddq43b08mc6titqp8mnk5g_rp22sh2s8i66or3cdgm0or0clh2bs "Countdown to Election Day")
---

Hey it's Marco and I just checked my watch - **we 're running out of time.**

I just don't know what to do. I keep asking myself, _" Is it even worth reaching out to them again?"_

I know you get a lot of these, and I know it can be overwhelming looking at all the requests. But if you respond to just 1 today, please, make it this one. I am being outraised 3 to 1, and polls are tied. They're saying this may be my closest race yet. **They 're saying I'm in the fight of my life.**

So, I'm humbly coming to you - hat in hand - asking one last time: **[Will you please send in just $17 to help me get our country back on track and prospering again?](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2ziocjd0eenti3eacgqnrlk3a0rvf0j1h766c30m0_rp22sh2s8i66or3cdgm0or0clh2bs "Will you please send in just $17 to help me get our country back on track and prospering again?")**

Fellow American,

I knew when I decided to run for office that my campaign would be met with support from a whole lot of folks, and I've been honored to see that support at hundreds of campaign stops across Georgia.

**But there are also racist bigots who want to demean me for the color of my skin and tear me apart because of my conservative viewpoints.**

I was attacked with racial slurs at a campaign event because I don't fit the Left's idea of what it means to be Black and conservative in America.

| _**"He's a joke. He tap dances, and he's a house n*****."**_
---

The reporters who were covering our event said _**nothing**_.

The local reporters who were covering our event questioned **no one** , despite urgent pleas from my campaign staff to do so. Unfortunately, this doesn't surprise me because that's the mainstream media for you. If Fox News had not reported it, the protester would've gotten away with it in plain sight.

name: Candace Owens
subject: I’ve received death threats… here’s why
body:
All because I am a Black woman with conservative values and because I believe that Black communities can overcome the victimhood
[](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zltoigipuercqm0vh8h5ckfumm6pi3hutao364v0_rp22sh2s8i66or3cdgm4o30slh2bs)

Hello Friend,

I've dealt with racism before. . . I've even received death threats.

All because I am a Black woman with conservative values and because I believe that Black communities can overcome the victimhood mentality.

I've watched Black Americans force-fed a message of victimhood, fear, defeat, and dependence for almost my entire life. Growing up, I remember being told I was "helpless."

This message -- which the media forces Black Americans to listen to -- is heartbreaking. _And it needs to stop_.

I co-founded the BLEXIT Foundation with Brandon Tatum to promote economic independence and individual freedom, strengthen the nuclear family, and foster a deeper appreciation for patriotism in Black American culture.

Our message to America's Black and minority communities is, _**" You don't have to be a victim."**_

[_**Will you please support the BLEXIT Foundation 's mission by helping me reach our goal of raising $50,000 from new online donors this month? You can **__**click here to donate >>>**_](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zivj8oqj8hg8hdna163denubb1gkoqvodggo12s0_rp22sh2s8i66or3cdgm4o30slh2bs)

Black communities are taught to believe that we're victims, that nothing will ever change, that police are our enemies, and that racism prevents us from ever achieving our goals.

This is WRONG! Giving up and becoming a victim is never the solution.

It's why BLEXIT is NOT just a "think tank," but a thoughtful and quick-acting "DO-tank." _**That 's all thanks to our BLEXIT State Chapters. **_

Our Chapters spread the universal principles of the movement at the local, grassroots level through community service, social engagement, educational activities, and virtual events.

Since 2019, BLEXIT has grown to reach 42 states with over 14,000 volunteers.

Friend, I am humbly asking you to support BLEXIT and help us spread our winning message of entrepreneurship, school choice, faith, and family. My goal is to raise $50,000 this week to support our mission.

[_**Please click here to donate $10, $50, $100, $250, $500, $1,000 or any amount >>>**_](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zaoonkig7lq65s7j1som4vird4eed2mj49t1uujg_rp22sh2s8i66or3cdgm4o30slh2bs)

Here are the BLEXIT Foundation's values, what we're doing to reach Black communities, and what we're fighting for:

* School Choice: Often, the people allegedly "fighting for minorities" are doing everything in their power to keep Black and Hispanic students locked into awful schools.

The ugly truth is that these schools are simply brainwashing centers attacking the nuclear family, creating victims, and teaching their twisted values.

BLEXIT Chapters promote and encourage others to seek alternative educational opportunities in their local communities. Educational opportunities for America's low-income and minority children and empower them to learn real skills, have more opportunities, and escape poverty.

[_**You can support BLEXIT 's efforts to fight for School Choice here >>>**_
](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zb2savit62n3cnk32l1uhirvsjo6gkskqbjgqou8_rp22sh2s8i66or3cdgm4o30slh2bs)
* Criminal Justice Reform: The mainstream media wants urban communities to hate our law enforcement officers, and this ugly message is setting Black Americans back.

Yes, we do need criminal justice reform. But we believe cooperating with our police officers and connecting as a community is critical to creating justice.

BLEXIT Chapter members lead educational programs to help communities avoid incarceration and foster better relationships between police officers and urban communities.

[_**Help the BLEXIT Foundation change the narrative by donating here >>>**_](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zmhtojvv38gjpki6jcph94359jjleu0ftuosbcl0_rp22sh2s8i66or3cdgm4o30slh2bs)

* Entrepreneurship: Free markets, responsibility, and advancing the careers of urban communities is the solution to poverty. The BLEXIT Foundation identifies young leaders in urban communities and helps them create resumes, practice interviews, and learn skills employers desire.

BLEXIT is not just talking a big game. . . Our Chapter members are actually connecting with community individuals to make a real impact in urban communities.

[_**Please help the BLEXIT Foundation encourage entrepreneurship and empower Black and Hispanic communities by donating here >>>**_](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2z0e8q1utv9svucmcm7r5icp84je38ivbv57m4bp0_rp22sh2s8i66or3cdgm4o30slh2bs)

* Teaching History: Critical Race Theory has nothing to do with solving race relations in our country. This is about division and spreading a victimhood message.

The BLEXIT Foundation believes in teaching real American history. Our urban communities must learn about our Founding Fathers and the Constitution to become productive and educated citizens.

It's why BLEXIT holds summer and after-school programs to teach children about these important lessons.

[_**Please help the BLEXIT Foundation teach real American history by donating here >>>**_](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zcnsa7htpgpdle8u0ggg5ht4ssis3pacuk8chfl8_rp22sh2s8i66or3cdgm4o30slh2bs)

* Presenting Our Message: The BLEXIT Foundation is going places where no one else goes. We're hosting events in Detroit, Baltimore, and Tampa and starting real conversations. These are urban communities that others ignore, communities that rely on the mainstream media to write their narrative.

These aren't boring events, and we're not just preaching to the choir. They have music, art, and real conversations. Most importantly, they are fun!

These exciting events are brought to life because of our State Chapters. Their hard work and creativity help our message reach new people and inspires communities to be victors, not victims.

[_**Please support BLEXIT 's events and help us spread our message by donating here >>>**_](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zp4bqu1377ou23nib42b7c0jhkkm928go8l2sgd0_rp22sh2s8i66or3cdgm4o30slh2bs)

This is personal to me -- I was once a slave to a culture of victimhood, but now I found my exit.

BLEXIT is the Black exit from the culture of victimhood, fear, and dependence forced upon us.**If you hold a permanent view of yourself as a victim, you become your own oppressor.**

Friend, I am asking you to join the BLEXIT Foundation by investing in our organization and helping us reach our goal of raising $50,000 this week. **Please click below to send your gift.**

[_**Donate $10 >>>**_](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2znaennfqb3pkl58m4sf7tjdu0gb9c90eu8cfp0tg_rp22sh2s8i66or3cdgm4o30slh2bs)
[_**Donate $35 >>>**_](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zqdf60k4nhkgto45ash8i2q8up51clhrbpc74cdg_rp22sh2s8i66or3cdgm4o30slh2bs)
[_**Donate $50 >>>**_](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zgllc2s440hjmdahmu1sb0u7tlm2gc083pet5st0_rp22sh2s8i66or3cdgm4o30slh2bs)
[_**Donate $100 >>>**_](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zqffjilo6k0o14sdkadqpl0hkrm4dra7uj1utif0_rp22sh2s8i66or3cdgm4o30slh2bs)
[_**Donate $250 >>>**_](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zhg502svcq4ffe1s1st6lpqaa9a8q9rth7s47uuo_rp22sh2s8i66or3cdgm4o30slh2bs)
[_**Donate $500 >>>**_](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zavod3ssqhuvk8ef6dsl90ho7ka7pjpg4pnmcts0_rp22sh2s8i66or3cdgm4o30slh2bs)
[_**Donate $1,000 >>>**_](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2z3c1jhvfb15jh3lsria9r69ke7bjb3g71gtle868_rp22sh2s8i66or3cdgm4o30slh2bs)
[_**Donate $2,500 >>>**_](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zlq5muf85dnrqsnaq9hfv1rnujhpb9pcfh2175s8_rp22sh2s8i66or3cdgm4o30slh2bs)
[_**Donate Any Amount >>>**_](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2z421bpofa8hf9taknuclu9e4huu7ov7gmf2mqja8_rp22sh2s8i66or3cdgm4o30slh2bs)

The BLEXIT Foundation believes in faith, family, and freedom. At the end of the day, our message to urban communities is about love and empowerment.

Thank you, Friend.

Candace Owens
Co-Founder & President
BLEXIT Foundation

**MEET MIKE:** | A CHAMPION FOR PRINCIPLED LEADERSHIP

Mike learned his love for the Constitution around the family dinner table. Mike’s father, Rex Lee, served as Solicitor General under President Ronald Reagan and later as President of Brigham Young University. As a child, Mike attended his father’s arguments before the U.S. Supreme Court, giving him a unique understanding of the government from an early age. As an attorney he developed a more complete understanding of why the Constitution is essential to the protection of life, liberty, and property.

After graduating from law school in 1997, he served as a law clerk to Judge Dee Benson of the U.S. District Court for the District of Utah. He then clerked for Judge Samuel A. Alito, Jr., who was serving at that time on the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Third Circuit Court in Newark, New Jersey. After his second clerkship, he joined the Washington, D.C. office of Sidley & Austin, where he specialized in appellate and Supreme Court litigation. Several years later, Mike was invited to serve as an Assistant U.S. Attorney in Salt Lake City, preparing briefs and arguing cases before the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Tenth Circuit. He served as Governor Huntsman’s General Counsel and then went to Washington for a one-year clerkship with Justice Alito at the U.S. Supreme Court.

Following his clerkship, Mike joined the Salt Lake office of the Washington, D.C.-based law firm of Howrey LLP. Mike has earned a reputation as an outstanding lawyer based on his sound judgment, writing and courtroom advocacy skills, and thorough understanding of the Constitution. Mike and Sharon have three children and live in Provo, Utah.

## The Greatest Oppressors Of Blacks In America...
---
Today, I just released **episode 3** of my new show "[Unfiltered w/Jackson Lahmeyer](https://sable.godaddy.com/c/375205?id=15004800.8741.1.d29633d85fc368d67533717d3e96066a)" On this show, I interview **Angela Stanton King**. This is a woman with an incredible story of awakening to the reality of the oppression the Democratic Party has inflicted upon the Black community in America. We discuss how the party of **slavery** , the **KKK** and **segregation** aka the **Democratic Party** has wrecked havoc in the lives of so many African Americans. Angela presents great insight not only to what the issues are but also what the solutions are as well. Be sure to subscribe to my [YouTube channel](https://sable.godaddy.com/c/375205?id=15004800.8742.1.de70a469a41e7de7041c33fc9b26ab64) to be notified each week of the newest episode. ## HUGE News!
---
| [ ](https://sable.godaddy.com/c/375205?id=15004800.8753.1.87b06178a2c94ae12faa5e44fd5c9811)
---
It's the _honor of my life_ to be the Pastor of [Sheridan.Church](https://sable.godaddy.com/c/375205?id=15004800.8754.1.ffbd63c12d7145b15401a51e94c3449b) in Tulsa, OK.
God has blessed our church with **tremendous growth**.
Last year, we launched a second Sunday service to make room for the growth.
Currently, we have services every Sunday at 9 & 11 am as well as Wednesday at 7pm.
**Our current location has been amazing, but we are outgrowing it.**
On Sundays at 11 am, I will find myself in the church lobby watching cars circle our parking lot trying to find a place to park because we have run out of parking before the service even begins and as a Pastor that's a horrible thing to see because your heart's desire is to reach people.
Last year, we began seeking the Lord for _direction_ on addressing this good problem.
God has poured out His favor on [Sheridan.Church](https://sable.godaddy.com/c/375205?id=15004800.8755.1.5d4d90948ca86865e1a9acdb3324f5f9)!
We have **acquired 6 acres in South Tulsa** between 81st and 91st off of Memorial.
I approached the owner of the 8 acres attached to the 6 acres we have acquired and asked what he would sell it to [Sheridan](https://sable.godaddy.com/c/375205?id=15004800.8756.1.e2ae8021da34774bed57d0bc0a8301aa) for and his response was reasonable. He said, "$750,000."
I then asked him if he would take $100,000 and he said, "**yes**."
**That's a MIRACLE!**
We are in a position to purchase 8 acres of prime real estate in South Tulsa for $100,000 that could be the potential home of [Sheridan.Church](https://sable.godaddy.com/c/375205?id=15004800.8757.1.0894686bb713d8992ea916091b823541) in the future.
Currently, [Sheridan.Church](https://sable.godaddy.com/c/375205?id=15004800.8758.1.b912d012441d7d8efd088a2feaa67235) is debt free, and I believe we should remain debt free.
**In order to remain out of debt, I need your help.**
We need to raise $100,000 over the next 60 days.
**So far, we have raised $85,000!**
I'm asking for you to come partner with what God is doing through [Sheridan.Church](https://sable.godaddy.com/c/375205?id=15004800.8759.1.ebac7b9cc800b50df85c1e14499f825f) and help expand the Kingdom of God.
A gift of $5 or $500 will be a HUGE help.
**If everyone that this email goes out to does something, we will have more than enough to acquire the 8 acres in cash.**
God is doing great things at [Sheridan](https://sable.godaddy.com/c/375205?id=15004800.8760.1.5bd554405ca79cfda022f7db3232e16d), and I believe if you help bless God's house that in-return God will bless your house.
Please ask the Lord if this is a project that you should partner with us in.
You can partner with us by visiting [www.sheridan.church/give](https://sable.godaddy.com/c/375205?id=15004800.8761.1.38060d64dd5dd232b896ecc8fb4e5056) and know that I am beyond grateful for your help.

name: Blake Masters
subject: I want you to know why I’m running to take back Arizona
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Blake Masters for Senate**
body:
I wanted to reach out personally | I know you've heard a lot from my campaign lately, but with only a few weeks left until the Election...

[](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61723912:JxgyqgVNA:m:1:3317145305:8982953493C273529D3B14CD2C965108:r)

Peter,

Do you have a minute?

I know you've heard a lot from my campaign lately, but with only a few weeks left until the Election, I wanted to take the time to reach out personally.

Let me start by telling you about myself and why I felt compelled to run for Senate: Arizona has helped shape my life for the better \- and I owe this state so much. I grew up here and am proud to still call Arizona home, along with my incredible wife Catherine and our three boys.

[](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61723912:JxgyqgVNA:m:1:3317145305:8982953493C273529D3B14CD2C965108:r)

That's why it's so deeply troubling to see what the failed leadership of the Biden administration and my opponent, Mark Kelly, have done to our nation.

Whether it is _**dangerous criminals**_ pouring across our unsecured border, _**crushing inflation**_ that is killing family-owned businesses, or _**teaching toxic ideologies**_ to our children, Democrats are destroying the America we know and love.

This country deserves so much better, **and I 'm running to create a more prosperous future for ALL Americans.**

[](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61723912:JxgyqgVNA:m:1:3317145305:8982953493C273529D3B14CD2C965108:r)

**[HELP DELIVER A BETTER FUTURE FOR ARIZONA AND AMERICA.>>](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61723912:JxgyqgVNA:m:1:3317145305:8982953493C273529D3B14CD2C965108:r)**

I know what it takes to tackle difficult problems and build success from scratch. I'm an America First outsider who has spent my career in the private sector creating jobs and investing in our youth. I'm committed to bringing YOUR voice to Washington _**and won 't EVER back down from fighting to put America First.**_

Let me be absolutely clear - _I 'm not interested in the political games of Washington._ I'm running for Senate because decent, hard-working people like **YOU** deserve solutions to the problems you face on a daily basis.

[](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61723912:JxgyqgVNA:m:1:3317145305:8982953493C273529D3B14CD2C965108:r)

We all know what is at stake on November 8th: The future of our state, our country, and control of the Senate. It is beyond critical that we restore **competent, conservative leadership** in Washington.

My race is extremely close and will be decided in this campaign's final days and weeks. I'm confident that united, we WILL win this election for the America First movement and begin building a better future for our nation. I'd be honored to have your support in this critical fight.

**[PLEASE CHIP IN ANY AMOUNT YOU CAN TO HELP US WIN THIS ELECTION FOR THE AMERICA FIRST MOVEMENT.>>](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61723912:JxgyqgVNA:m:1:3317145305:8982953493C273529D3B14CD2C965108:r)**

Thank you,

Blake Masters
U.S. Senate Candidate from Arizona

**[CONTRIBUTE NOW>>](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61723912:JxgyqgVNA:m:1:3317145305:8982953493C273529D3B14CD2C965108:r)**

PeterI’m running for Governor of Kentucky and people keep telling me that if I want to win I have to kiss Mitch McConnel’s ring.Personally, I think Mitch McConnell needs to retire from politics and stay out of our business.If that isn’t how politics works, tough. I’m not here to fake.Can we just go ahead and talk about the elephant in the room?Senator McConnell wields a great deal of power in this country and he likes to lie through his teeth and tell the Constitutional Conservatives of Kentucky that he represents them, but he does not! Ole Mitch may be from the Bluegrass State but he does not represent us. Everyone knows he has an “R” after his name, but he looks more like the Democrats instead.In addition to working with the leftists and stabbing Kentuckians in the back in the Senate, Mitch is trying to tinker in the race I’m running in: the Governor’s race. You didn’t think he was going to sit back and be satisfied with the power he had, did you? Of course not!
So, what kind of governor are national elites like Mitch McConnell trying to put in the Governor’s office? They want a candidate that looks just like he does: weak and willing to caucus with leftists if it keeps power.
| [DON’T LET MITCH MCCONNELL HAVE MORE POWER!](https://breakingconservativedaily.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=22432bec7f541233c6007cfc2&id=db62db312e&e=fdefed58de)
---
You know that we can’t let Mitch get his way. He is desperate to keep me out of the Governor’s office because he knows I would stand up to weak-kneed RINOs who have sold out Kentucky and this country.In order to get elected, however, I must have your support. This race can be won but my team and I need the funds to break through the Leftist media spin about this race. We need to let the good Patriots of this state know about how I want to bring common sense and freedom to the Governor’s office.A strong Governor can make a difference not just in their state - but in the entire nation. Just look at how Ron DeSantis has inspired the nation through his work in Florida. I aim to fight as hard as Ron DeSantis. I am another candidate in the mold of Kari Lake and others, and I’ll govern as a Constitutional Conservative.We will set an example for the country so people can see what TRUE liberty looks like.However, time is not on our side. Mitch and the RINO elites are pulling out all the stops to defeat me. Peter,

I knew when I decided to run for office that my campaign would be met with support from a whole lot of folks, and I've been honored to see that support at hundreds of campaign stops across Georgia.

**But there are also racist bigots who want to demean me for the color of my skin and tear me apart because of my conservative viewpoints.**

| _**"He's a joke. He tap dances, and he's a house n*****."**_

The reporters who were covering our event said _**nothing**_.

Growing up, I had a speech impediment. I was embarrassed to speak up in class or to ask my teachers for help, so my grades suffered in elementary school. I lived in fear of what my classmates might do or say to me on the playground.

My parents were extremely hardworking people, but they didn't have a lot of money. They couldn't afford to send me to a private school or hire a specialist to help me improve my speech. All roads in my small town of Wrightsville seemed to indicate that I would struggle for the rest of my time in school. Luckily for me, that was not the end of my story.

After helping my high school football team win a state championship, I continued playing football at the University of Georgia. I helped the Bulldogs win the 1980 national championship, and I capped my college career by winning the 1982 Heisman Trophy. I played 15 years in the USFL and NFL for several incredible teams. I then had the honor of representing the United States in the 1992 Winter Olympics in bobsledding.

_**I am proof the American Dream is alive and well.**_

_**[Help Republicans retake Congress and save the American Dream.>>](http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/ct/60988785:sDM-PShpN:m:1:2532013465:FF4B4FF1E1FAC8182195106D902E8B85:r)**_

Fellow American, it's sad this is the type of environment we're running in, but it's a pattern from the Left we've seen numerous times throughout this campaign. Ron was also a leading champion for America's veterans and helped enact reforms to the VA and place an emphasis on mental health. clean_body: | Fellow Conservative, Ron DeSantis is America's Governor. He leads with courage, conviction, and principle on behalf of Floridians. He is dedicated to the people of Florida and proudly represents the state he's called home since his birth. | Ron worked and paid his way through college, where he played baseball and served as the team captain. Ron graduated Cum Laude from Yale University with a B.S. in History. | After graduating from college, Ron attended Harvard Law School where he volunteered to serve the U.S. Navy. During his tenure on active-duty, Ron deployed to Iraq as an adviser to a U.S. Navy SEAL commander. Attached to SEAL Team 1, Ron was awarded the Bronze Star for Meritorious Service and the Iraq Campaign Medal. | I met Ron while he was on active duty stationed at Mayport Naval Base in Northeast Florida. While on active-duty, Ron was appointed to the U.S. Attorney's Office and served as a federal prosecutor, where he led efforts to convict child predators. Ron and I were married in 2009 and lived in Ponte Vedra Beach, Florida. | Continuing his call to serve, Ron ran for U.S. Congress. Winning a seven-way primary with 38% of the vote, Ron won his first three terms in Congress. While in office, Ron advocated for congressional term limits and a balanced budget amendment. He also spearheaded oversight efforts to expose malfeasance in the IRS and in agencies involved in abusing their authority during the manufacturing of the Russia collusion conspiracy theory. Ron was also a leading champion for America's veterans and helped enact reforms to the VA and place an emphasis on mental health. In 2016, Ron and I embarked on our most important role yet - parenthood. From the moment she was born, our blessing, Madison, forever changed our lives. | Shortly after she was born, Ron launched his campaign for Governor. 2018 was one of the most eventful years of our lives as Ron was elected the 46th Governor of Florida and we welcomed our son Mason to the world. In 2020, we became a party of five with the birth of our daughter Mamie. She was the first baby born to a sitting Governor in more than 50 years. I've watched Ron excel as a Navy JAG officer, federal prosecutor, U.S. Congressman, and now Governor, but his role as a father to our three little ones has by far been the most rewarding. | As a father, he understood the risks of keeping kids locked out of the classroom and the ramifications of force-masking our children - so as Governor, he passed legislation to prohibit mandates and empower parents. He foresaw the detrimental effects of shuttering businesses and as a result, he rejected draconian lockdowns and kept the state of Florida open for business. As a federal prosecutor, Ron understood the importance of upholding the rule of law and supporting our brave men and women in law enforcement. As the leader of our state, Ron rejected calls from the Left to defund the police while making it known that Florida is a law-and-order state. But if you want to know who Ron DeSantis really is, when I was diagnosed with cancer and I was facing the battle for my life, he was the dad who took care of my children when I couldn't. He was there to pick me off of the ground when I literally could not stand. He was there to fight for me when I didn't have the strength to fight for myself. That is who Ron DeSantis is. | He accomplished a lot over the past three and a half years, but our fight has only just begun. Extreme Leftists around the nation are turning once beautiful cities into woke wastelands. Blue states are giving more consideration to dangerous criminals than their own citizens. Ron's opponent has voted in support of the Biden regime 100% of the time in Congress. He's made known his plans to impose vaccine mandates on Floridians - including children - defund the police, and indoctrinate our children with the Left's woke ideologies. As someone passionate to end abortion, you need to know what’s been going on the last few weeks.
[View this message in your browser](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z4gd8mel4msbtjosqb8roll62rn616tpb6a57auo_rp2ash2s8gb2sbgeppef9t56egn4tblm1on4t1kmepradrmeej3fddnkgp7cc5kmdqjf972u9hf6p70sljjfddnmpr62c9jmgqjac3gcsr33cb4eqprfcdgs9in4o35mlrrcp3ge1jt4s3icgr31cj6e9q32tj0s2q6ac70mkom9pj6cooj1ddjcup3ephkc2pm8ptgmlin48d245p25oh4cdhm6or1ctg64o724no)

---
#
Friend of life,

As someone passionate to end abortion, you need to know what’s been going on the last few weeks.

Since Roe v. Wade was overturned, millions of dollars have been poured by donors into pro-abortion groups. They have one goal in mind: use this mountain of cash to fuel a landslide win for pro-abortion candidates this November.

Planned Parenthood and NARAL Pro-Choice America saw overall contributions increase from $630,000 to roughly $2.3 million in just three months. Every donation represents another baby in danger of death by abortion.

Meanwhile, pro-life groups across the country are struggling to keep up as donors have stopped giving. Too many people have viewed the end of Roe v. Wade as the end of the battle when it is just the beginning.

We need to activate courageous pro-life people before midnight tonight so we can stay in the fight and reach 34,000 moms before it’s too late. Will you take a stand with us? Give now: **[https://give.liveaction.org/fight-back/](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zfd21vh5lg80g9iq26reghn7i2e1mvmntoes9990_rp22sh2s8i66or3cdgmeo32c3h2bs)**

Friend of Life - this is a David vs. Goliath battle.

We are up against a billion-dollar industry and lobby with the financial backing and support of the elites, the media, Hollywood, and higher education - and Planned Parenthood and its allies are increasing their spending and political action ahead of the mid-term elections.

Why?

Because they want to ensure that Americans reject the Court’s ruling on Roe v. Wade and expand abortion nationwide, rather than end it once and for all.

Polls show that Americans are increasing in their support of abortion-on-demand and even pro-life states could be on the verge of expanding abortion in the next few months. The 24/7 media barrage funded by committed pro-abortion donors is working and if we don’t move quickly, all of our progress over the last 40 years may disappear.

We have no time to lose and your gift RIGHT NOW will save babies from being poisoned, torn apart, and suctioned from their mother’s wombs: **[https://give.liveaction.org/fight-back/](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zvrgfigh19bpm0d38n8rc3cj3jej8ootpjnh47fg_rp22sh2s8i66or3cdgmeo32c3h2bs)**

Your unwavering conviction and commitment to this fight is why I have hope for our future. We will prevail in every state and overcome the horrific injustice of abortion as we spread the truth, one heart and one life at a time.

For life,

**Lila Rose**
Founder and President

name: Ron DeSantis
subject: I just stepped off the stage
body:
I just stepped off the debate stage, and it's now clearer than ever -- Charlie Crist is dangerous for Florida.
[Unsubscribe](http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/oWUyozSh_N)
**[](http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/ct/60989425:WUyozSh_N:m:1:2532013465:36A76C68CB9F7A8BED6F74D78F32F927:r)**

Friend,
I just stepped off the debate stage, and it's now clearer than ever -- Charlie Crist is dangerous for Florida.

His allegiance to the far-Left's extreme agenda puts Floridians at risk of facing the same fate as other failed blue states around the country.

On every topic, Charlie Crist takes the most extreme stance -- right in line with the Democrat Machine.

[**STOP THE BIDEN-CRIST AGENDA**](http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/ct/60989425:WUyozSh_N:m:1:2532013465:36A76C68CB9F7A8BED6F74D78F32F927:r)

Over the course of the night, Charlie cemented for Floridians that:
* He votes 100% of the time with Joe Biden, and like the rest of the Democrats, he wants the government to control your kids. If it were up to Charlie, Florida schools would subject students to forced COVID jabs and indoctrination with woke ideologies.
* If it were up to Charlie, Florida would be a sanctuary state. He cares more about advancing Biden's open border agenda than keeping Floridians safe.
* Charlie's jailbreak agenda is in lockstep with the radical pro-crime views of Soros-affiliated prosecutors who are allowing criminals to wreak havoc in cities across our nation. His rejection of law and order would put Floridians in danger.
* Charlie spent the last two years serving as a rubber stamp for the Biden Regime and wants nothing more than to bring the Biden Regime's destructive policies to Florida.

What's more, Friend, _**Charlie only showed up to work 14 days this year**_ , because he isn't interested in performing the duties of the many offices he has run for in his political career spanning five decades.

_**Not surprising coming from Biden's biggest cheerleader.**_

Throughout the night, Charlie dutifully played his role as a political puppet for the Biden Regime.

Since day one, Charlie has praised Biden's failed policies and declared at every opportunity that he considers Joe Biden the "greatest president of our lifetime" -- yes, the same Biden who has been plunging our country into a downward spiral since he took office.

Charlie made clear that he will take his orders from a puppet who can hardly read from a teleprompter.

_**Truth be told, Friend, I'm wary of anyone who matches Biden's agenda, rhetoric, and confused, empty gaze. I think I can speak for most Floridians when I say they don't want another Joe Biden infiltrating our state.**_

__**[
](http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/ct/60989426:WUyozSh_N:m:1:2532013465:36A76C68CB9F7A8BED6F74D78F32F927:r "https://click.email.rondesantis.com/?qs=73266c88efed0650b7b20ae383035f0020611e95fb74e7e5f7c111768228fb8748f204127d946cf208f732102135b6466d0e6363a7d817bd")**__[**STOP THE BIDEN-CRIST AGENDA**](http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/ct/60989425:WUyozSh_N:m:1:2532013465:36A76C68CB9F7A8BED6F74D78F32F927:r)
My opponent talked a lot about decency, Friend, I'm not really sure what's decent about locking people in their homes, destroying their businesses, and keeping children out of school.

Aside from comparing himself to Tom Brady and Jesus Christ, I can't think of anything more ridiculous than Charlie Crist asking Floridians to trust him.

In the end, Charlie lost the fight to shut down schools, lost the fight to shut down businesses, lost the fight to lock people in their homes, and now, we need to come together as Floridians to deliver his destructive policies a loss once and for all.

__**[Stand with me to Keep Florida Free! Rush in an immediate donation now-- trust me, this is the single most important thing you can do.](http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/ct/60989425:WUyozSh_N:m:1:2532013465:36A76C68CB9F7A8BED6F74D78F32F927:r "Stand with me to Keep Florida Free! Rush in an immediate donation
now — trust me, this is the single most important thing you can do.")**__

Thank you for your support,
Ron DeSantis

[RUSH IN A DONATION](http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/ct/60989425:WUyozSh_N:m:1:2532013465:36A76C68CB9F7A8BED6F74D78F32F927:r)

| | **This last session of Congress, Democrats passed the Inflation Reduction Act, which lowered health care and prescription drug costs.** For those like us who believe health care is a right, this is good news: Democrats **capped the cost of insulin** for seniors on Medicare at $35 per month. We gave **Medicare the negotiating power to lower prescription drug prices**. **We capped out-of-pocket medical costs** for seniors at $2,000 per month. **And we capped health care premiums,** which will save the average Washington family up to $3,400 per year. This progress is needed now more than ever, with people and families feeling the effects of the growing cost of living and a tightening economy. It was the result of elected leaders working quietly and diligently to bring down the costs for working families and seniors, and it will make a real difference to thousands of household budgets here in Northwest Washington. **Of course, there is still much to be done** to bring down health care costs and ensure that everyone has access to quality, affordable care – which is why Congress must stay focused in the next session. This is where you come in. **All of this progress was made without a single Republican vote.** Keeping Congress blue is the key to continuing our efforts to make health care more affordable. **[If you clean_body: | | | | This last session of Congress, Democrats passed the Inflation Reduction Act, which lowered health care and prescription drug costs. For those like us who believe health care is a right, this is good news: Democrats capped the cost of insulin for seniors on Medicare at $35 per month. We gave Medicare the negotiating power to lower prescription drug prices. We capped out-of-pocket medical costs for seniors at $2,000 per month. And we capped health care premiums, which will save the average Washington family up to $3,400 per year. This progress is needed now more than ever, with people and families feeling the effects of the growing cost of living and a tightening economy. It was the result of elected leaders working quietly and diligently to bring down the costs for working families and seniors, and it will make a real difference to thousands of household budgets here in Northwest Washington. Of course, there is still much to be done to bring down health care costs and ensure that everyone has access to quality, affordable care – which is why Congress must stay focused in the next session. This is where you come in. All of this progress was made without a single Republican vote. body:
Elissa Slotkin for Congresssecure.actblue.com/donate/slotkinq42022?refcode=email20221024&amount=28 [secure.actblue.com/donate/slotkinq42022?refcode=email20221024&amount=28]
Team,
We had a full day in the 7th district this past weekend. It was the return of our cider mill tour, which we called Cider in the Seventh. There were 6 in total: Spicer Orchards, Blake’s Orchard, Grainger Orchard, Clearview Orchard, Cottage Creek Orchard, and Uncle John’s Cider Mill.
We started out the day bright and early at Spicer Orchards in Livingston County. In order to make it through a packed day of cider and donuts, I also tried to buy something unique to that cider mill at every stop – at Spicer’s it was maple cream and frosted apple cinnamon bread.
Then, we were on to Blake’s Orchard in South Lyon. Congressman Joe Neguse joined me at this stop and I was able to show him all Michigan has to offer. We even got a hard cider tasting in before 11 am.

Next was Grainger Orchard in Howell and Clearview Orchard in Haslett. Big or small, mid-Michigan knows how to harvest some tasty apples. These two stops were perfect for apple picking. With all of the bees out on Sunday, I had to pick up some local honey.
secure.actblue.com/donate/slotkinq42022?refcode=email20221024&amount=28 [secure.actblue.com/donate/slotkinq42022?refcode=email20221024&amount=28]
Cottage Creek Orchard in Mason was next. The Casali family built the space from the ground up, overlooking a beautiful orchard. A true testament to living their dream in MI07. Plus, the boys had a great game day setup while they were cleaning and sorting apples in the back.
secure.actblue.com/donate/slotkinq42022?refcode=email20221024&amount=28 [secure.actblue.com/donate/slotkinq42022?refcode=email20221024&amount=28]
We wrapped up the day at Uncle Johns. Going to Uncle Johns is like the Super Bowl of cider mills in the new 7th, so it was only fitting that we end the day with a bang. My brother and niece were in town this weekend and were able to join me for the last few stops. Each of my campaigns has been a family affair, and I love involving my nieces and nephews whenever I can.
As an added bonus, I ended the day at Horrocks – a Lansing area staple that's part grocery store, part farmers market, part restaurant, and part beer garden. We grabbed some dinner and I was able to get in a little grocery shopping (a rare win during campaign season).
We could not have asked for a more beautiful fall day on the campaign trail. Even though days like this are packed, I’m energized when I get to spend time saying hello to people in the district who are out and about. subject: These 4 Freedom Caucuses Are on Fire
body:
| | | |
---
| | | Friends, The Establishment operates at a full-time capacity - 365 days a year. Same with the woke bureaucrats and the agencies they run. Same with the lobbyists and the corporations that fund them. But part-time lawmakers usually head back home after their legislative session is over, leaving the Establishment to control the agenda for months and months on end. **_The State Freedom Caucus Network puts a stop to that_**. We help part-time lawmakers become a full-time counterforce to the Establishment. Even when they are out of session, state freedom caucuses are pushing back against the Radical Left and the GOP Establishment that often enables them. Here are just some of the things the state freedom caucuses have been doing lately: The **Illinois Freedom Caucus** is demanding that Chicago’s Lurie Children’s Hospital stop providing transgender services to innocent children. Thanks to the ILFC’s efforts, the issue is becoming a wedge of contention in the governor’s race. From a [local press story](https://statefreedomcaucus.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a363d70ccaaebc9e5732e6783&id=c16afb731c&e=64ecec6d03): “Gov. J.B. Pritzker and GOP nominee Darren Bailey were asked about gender-affirming care for Illinois youth as the November election nears...The Illinois Freedom Caucus, which consists of state lawmakers who support Bailey, said it will introduce legislation "to ban chemical castrations and gender surgeries for minors in Illinois." Until that is approved, the group called on the Ann and Robert H. Lurie Children's Hospital of Chicago "to cease providing these services to minors." The **South Carolina Freedom Caucus** is trying to end abortion completely in their state. But “Republican” members of the state senate are trying to expand abortion beyond what’s in current law! In [a recent letter](https://statefreedomcaucus.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a363d70ccaaebc9e5732e6783&id=e0ef10f753&e=64ecec6d03), the South Carolina Freedom Caucus wrote, “Despite years of signing pro-life pledges, accepting endorsements from our state’s leading pro-life groups, and campaigning on pro-life platforms, a number of “Republican” senators sided with radical Democrats with one mission today – to insist on a period of time that abortion-on-demand remains as a form of birth control in South Carolina.” **Arizona Freedom Caucus** Chairman Jake Hoffman recently wrote an op-ed titled, [2 Million Illegals & Counting: Democrats’ Weapon To Destroy America](https://statefreedomcaucus.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a363d70ccaaebc9e5732e6783&id=a0202f59df&e=64ecec6d03). Excerpt: "The Democrats haven’t merely left our southern border vulnerable, their policies have incentivized more than two million illegal aliens to invade the United States since Biden took office. Border towns are being overrun, prisons are filling to capacity, and hardworking Americans are being hurt, yet President Biden had the audacity to claim the “border is closed” on 60 Minutes." The **South Dakota Freedom Caucus** has long sought to repeal their state’s sales tax on groceries. Until recently, Governor Kristi Noem actively opposed that effort. Sensing vulnerability in her re-election effort, she recently came out in support of repealing the tax. Here’s [an excerpt](https://statefreedomcaucus.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a363d70ccaaebc9e5732e6783&id=32fb35a399&e=64ecec6d03) from a local report: “A group of South Dakota lawmakers is happy about Gov. Kristi Noem’s campaign promise to cut the grocery food sales tax. The South Dakota Freedom Caucus, which calls itself “elected officials who believe in freedom and liberty for the people of South Dakota,” said it applauds Noem’s announcement. “It’s a pleasant surprise,” Freedom Caucus Chairman Rep. Aaron Aylward (R-Harrisburg) said in a news release. “We’re happy to see the Governor have a change of heart to help some of our less fortunate families and children that are the most adversely affected by this type of taxation scheme.” And from State Freedom Caucus Network’s headquarters: I was also recently on **OAN’s “Nights with Chris Boyle”** show [to discuss](https://statefreedomcaucus.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a363d70ccaaebc9e5732e6783&id=95f67a31ee&e=64ecec6d03) the State Freedom Caucus Network’s efforts to help create freedom caucuses in all 50 states. Please check it out. **Free to Offend!** That’s the name of a podcast I recently joined [to discuss](https://statefreedomcaucus.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a363d70ccaaebc9e5732e6783&id=9f013768ea&e=64ecec6d03) the State Freedom Caucus Network’s efforts. The podcast is hosted by our good friends at the Nevada Policy Research Institute. Here’s how they described the episode: “While everyone likes to pay most of their attention to national politics, it’s actually the local politics that usually matter the most for limiting the size and scope of government. There’s a reason so many people from over-regulated and high-tax states are flocking to low-tax western states — it’s because, regardless of what’s going on nationally, states like Nevada still have a culture that prioritizes individual freedom. And preserving that culture is going to require keeping our efforts focused where it matters the most: In our own state’s legislature. Andrew Roth, president of the State Freedom Caucus Network, joined the program to talk about his effort to keep that culture of freedom alive in local politics throughout the nation.” Take a listen while you go for a walk or commute to work.

Thank you for your continued support.

Keep fighting,

Andy Roth
President, [State Freedom Caucus Network](https://statefreedomcaucus.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a363d70ccaaebc9e5732e6783&id=610356187e&e=64ecec6d03)

Aaron Aylward (R-Harrisburg) said in a news release. “We’re happy to see the Governor have a change of heart to help some of our less fortunate families and children that are the most adversely affected by this type of taxation scheme.” And from State Freedom Caucus Network’s headquarters: I was also recently on OAN’s “Nights with Chris Boyle” show the State Freedom Caucus Network’s efforts to help create freedom caucuses in all 50 states. Please check it out. Free to Offend! That’s the name of a podcast I recently joined the State Freedom Caucus Network’s efforts. The podcast is hosted by our good friends at the Nevada Policy Research Institute. Here’s how they described the episode: “While everyone likes to pay most of their attention to national politics, it’s actually the local politics that usually matter the most for limiting the size and scope of government. There’s a reason so many people from over-regulated and high-tax states are flocking to low-tax western states — it’s because, regardless of what’s going on nationally, states like Nevada still have a culture that prioritizes individual freedom. And preserving that culture is going to require keeping our efforts focused where it matters the most: In our own state’s legislature. Andrew Roth, president of the State Freedom Caucus Network, joined the program to talk about his effort to keep that culture of freedom alive in local politics throughout the nation.” Take a listen while you go for a walk or commute to work. Thank you for your continued support. Keep fighting, Andy Roth President, | "CLICK HERE TO DONATE" | | | | | Copyright © 2022 State Freedom Caucus Network, All rights reserved.

| |
---
| | | Hi, I'm Adam Laxalt, and this is my story.

---
| [](http://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=c71b1db3a7c749c888da55a0b8045bfe&_e=xWijHnKnyf214cGswYHH_r3nhOTIxrEGLKeDtefaipGfXwEidseOrwgcqbiol-5gMWYVwWXAfpxZTf51b5oZyevAdZze9vc37ahXqzaLbJaoYAwK9NvpkxgOMHXsh3A6M4IReQdDQ5EMFuDuQCsVNmKebzay00IGP7X8GEkTDSlJIdtn-AGC94Q3gEQhXjexpoeye6zNn-kzGQUB6k7ARxZ2dbhGiJkYg9o1Euihq0Udsj4fvUvc0k8xnB08Zt_a4DfhWrGMcudvvQZYTgdBtxHgSXDoWL2bFOzr3M2y2Nk7YxP8FgEFbhaeHYpDX_43R3-4npMMr0gMrWJUPtJ9iVYDWDDRzxlhOh_mSqLCZvxoya858ZzTpBhvTu2erNJHPYnrG3oTiU4k_OLt4V6gXOxsRGK2MD1AOSY3zGi28WU%3D "Adam 1")
---

I didn't know who my father was. I was born to a single mother in the 1970s. She was in her early 20s, had no college degree, and faced enormous pressure to not bring me into this world. But through faith, she chose to give me the chance to live, and I'll be forever grateful for that opportunity.

---
| [](http://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=c71b1db3a7c749c888da55a0b8045bfe&_e=xWijHnKnyf214cGswYHH_r3nhOTIxrEGLKeDtefaipGfXwEidseOrwgcqbiol-5gMWYVwWXAfpxZTf51b5oZyevAdZze9vc37ahXqzaLbJaoYAwK9NvpkxgOMHXsh3A6M4IReQdDQ5EMFuDuQCsVNmKebzay00IGP7X8GEkTDSlJIdtn-AGC94Q3gEQhXjexpoeye6zNn-kzGQUB6k7ARxZ2dbhGiJkYg9o1Euihq0Udsj4fvUvc0k8xnB08Zt_a4DfhWrGMcudvvQZYTgdBt4S0E6jyqjIP3aC_2TRU4eQ-d2UZleZfKN-MFJBLCFl8aGU1vA2K4xomIlFyiSL4ZYDR7xESbL80mqBpK5vohJ1Y6yMJuhwR3VMLpqIVFh7seYl-ylvJp_-dwfOJ3gKjnTIbZjSbwxbEjV4Uw4Si10A%3D "Adam 2")
---

Although my childhood wasn't always easy, my experiences shaped me into the person I am today. I learned the power of faith and the importance of family and community. Without these things, there is no way I could've accomplished everything that I have.

---
| [](http://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=c71b1db3a7c749c888da55a0b8045bfe&_e=xWijHnKnyf214cGswYHH_r3nhOTIxrEGLKeDtefaipGfXwEidseOrwgcqbiol-5gMWYVwWXAfpxZTf51b5oZyevAdZze9vc37ahXqzaLbJaoYAwK9NvpkxgOMHXsh3A6M4IReQdDQ5EMFuDuQCsVNmKebzay00IGP7X8GEkTDSlJIdtn-AGC94Q3gEQhXjexpoeye6zNn-kzGQUB6k7ARxZ2dbhGiJkYg9o1Euihq0Udsj4fvUvc0k8xnB08Zt_a4DfhWrGMcudvvQZYTgdBt3AOKS4w6jher0TCWVENHPV1VIsjP_pwqeklQBpUyNDOWaWpxXeNnEixCX_KIjmE_goc0e57Hs_b_Vm3zfyIR1Bz1nHne8cs7V9c9QIShHhNwF454EdS2MBJ5erxpow2jqZM7OsPyyBMRbT1HFWRZFQ%3D "Adam 3")
---

After 9/11 attacks, I joined the US Navy - I always knew I wanted to serve my country, but after that date, I knew I needed to act. As a Naval Officer and Iraq Veteran, I served in detainee operations and assisted in the detention and prosecution of more than 20,000 detainees.

---

She’s worked hard every day to protect the rights of every New Yorker, from the Bronx to Niagara Falls. But Peter, her fight for justice is far from over. Because right now, with voting rights, reproductive rights, LGBTQ+ rights, gun safety, and more on the line, New Yorkers deserve an attorney general who will do whatever it takes to defend us. = | | = Peter, both Letitia and I agree that there is no greater place in the world than New York. That’s why we’re working so hard to improve it – to expand voting rights, ensure everyone has autonomy over their bodies, and keep illegal guns off our streets. I consider myself incredibly lucky to have an attorney general and friend who is so dedicated to ensuring that every New Yorker has the means to live a good life, but she’s relying on our help to win re-election. So please: = | | = Thank you for helping to build a better future for our fellow New Yorkers. Siempre, Lin-Manuel | This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com. James for NY P.O. **MEET MIKE:** | A CHAMPION FOR PRINCIPLED LEADERSHIP

Mike learned his love for the Constitution around the family dinner table. Mike’s father, Rex Lee, served as Solicitor General under President Ronald Reagan and later as President of Brigham Young University. As a child, Mike attended his father’s arguments before the U.S. Supreme Court, giving him a unique understanding of the government from an early age. As an attorney he developed a more complete understanding of why the Constitution is essential to the protection of life, liberty, and property.

After graduating from law school in 1997, he served as a law clerk to Judge Dee Benson of the U.S. District Court for the District of Utah. He then clerked for Judge Samuel A. Alito, Jr., who was serving at that time on the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Third Circuit Court in Newark, New Jersey. After his second clerkship, he joined the Washington, D.C. office of Sidley & Austin, where he specialized in appellate and Supreme Court litigation. Several years later, Mike was invited to serve as an Assistant U.S. Attorney in Salt Lake City, preparing briefs and arguing cases before the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Tenth Circuit. He served as Governor Huntsman’s General Counsel and then went to Washington for a one-year clerkship with Justice Alito at the U.S. Supreme Court.

Following his clerkship, Mike joined the Salt Lake office of the Washington, D.C.-based law firm of Howrey LLP. Mike has earned a reputation as an outstanding lawyer based on his sound judgment, writing and courtroom advocacy skills, and thorough understanding of the Constitution. Mike and Sharon have three children and live in Provo, Utah.

As a child, Mike attended his father’s arguments before the U.S. Supreme Court, giving him a unique understanding of the government from an early age. As an attorney he developed a more complete understanding of why the Constitution is essential to the protection of life, liberty, and property. After graduating from law school in 1997, he served as a law clerk to Judge Dee Benson of the U.S. District Court for the District of Utah. He then clerked for Judge Samuel A. Alito, Jr., who was serving at that time on the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Third Circuit Court in Newark, New Jersey. After his second clerkship, he joined the Washington, D.C. office of Sidley & Austin, where he specialized in appellate and Supreme Court litigation. Several years later, Mike was invited to serve as an Assistant U.S. Attorney in Salt Lake City, preparing briefs and arguing cases before the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Tenth Circuit. He served as Governor Huntsman’s General Counsel and then went to Washington for a one-year clerkship with Justice Alito at the U.S. Supreme Court. Following his clerkship, Mike joined the Salt Lake office of the Washington, D.C.-based law firm of Howrey LLP. Mike has earned a reputation as an outstanding lawyer based on his sound judgment, writing and courtroom advocacy skills, and thorough understanding of the Constitution. Mike and Sharon have three children and live in Provo, Utah. | | | ---|---|--- | Paid for by Friends of Mike Lee, Inc. PO Box 1537 Salt Lake City, UT 84110

subject: I just stepped off the stage
body:
To view this email as a web page, go to the link below, or copy and paste it into your browser's address window.
https://view.email.rondesantis.com/?qs=e366b981e5bb0888411a153efd27d6d92c53f07ae385eee1633da28ffe0604420a0f942ef79b624ce8e38544b5ed93bfcb35761dc2f6742b53c77382dd40740fa208da9ea09d32d1cdd7ef50a171dce8

Peter,

I just stepped off the debate stage, and it’s now clearer than ever — Charlie Crist is dangerous for Florida.

His allegiance to the far-Left’s extreme agenda puts Floridians at risk of facing the same fate as other failed blue states around the country.

On every topic, Charlie Crist takes the most extreme stance — right in line with the Democrat Machine.

https://click.email.rondesantis.com/?qs=3bd8b83903a7b09f9a5a93b70ca00076ca9bd6184c099acdc793e2a278d0e59fc067687941844941959d048ff758fc982d5878bb0207e1f2
REJECT CHARLIE'S EXTREME AGENDA

Over the course of the night, Charlie cemented for Floridians that:

▪️ He votes 100% of the time with Joe Biden, and like the rest of the Democrats, he wants the government to control your kids. If it were up to Charlie, Florida schools would subject students to forced COVID jabs and indoctrination with woke ideologies.

▪️ If it were up to Charlie, Florida would be a sanctuary state. He cares more about advancing Biden’s open border agenda than keeping Floridians safe.

▪️ Charlie’s jailbreak agenda is in lockstep with the radical pro-crime views of Soros-affiliated prosecutors who are allowing criminals to wreak havoc in cities across our nation. His rejection of law and order would put Floridians in danger.

▪️ Charlie spent the last two years serving as a rubber stamp for the Biden Regime and wants nothing more than to bring the Biden Regime’s destructive policies to Florida.

What's more, Peter, Charlie only showed up to work 14 days this year, because he isn’t interested in performing the duties of the many offices he has run for in his political career spanning five decades. How many jobs pay you $174,000 a year to only show up to work 14 days??

Not surprising coming from Biden’s biggest cheerleader.

Throughout the night, Charlie dutifully played his role as a political puppet for the Biden Regime.

Since day one of his campaign, Charlie has praised Biden’s failed policies and declared at every opportunity that he considers Joe Biden the “greatest president of our lifetime” — yes, the same Biden who has been plunging our country into a downward spiral since he took office.

Charlie made clear that, if elected, he will continue to take his orders from a puppet who can hardly read from a teleprompter.

Truth be told, Peter, I’m wary of any candidate who matches Biden’s agenda, rhetoric, and confused, empty gaze. I think I can speak for most Floridians when I say they don’t want another Joe Biden running this state.

https://click.email.rondesantis.com/?qs=3bd8b83903a7b09f9a5a93b70ca00076ca9bd6184c099acdc793e2a278d0e59fc067687941844941959d048ff758fc982d5878bb0207e1f2
KEEP BIDEN'S PUPPET OUT OF FLORIDA

My opponent talked a lot about decency, Peter, I’m not really sure what’s decent about locking people in their homes, destroying their businesses, and keeping children out of school.

Aside from comparing himself to Tom Brady and Jesus Christ, I can’t think of anything more ridiculous than Charlie Crist asking Floridians to trust him.

In the end, Charlie lost the fight to shut down schools, lost the fight to shut down businesses, lost the fight to lock people in their homes, and now, we need to come together as Floridians to deliver him a loss in his latest bid for the governor’s office.

The clock is ticking. Early Voting has already started. I need to know that I have your support heading into this final stretch of the campaign as I go head-to-head against the Democrat Machine.
https://click.email.rondesantis.com/?qs=3bd8b83903a7b09f9a5a93b70ca00076ca9bd6184c099acdc793e2a278d0e59fc067687941844941959d048ff758fc982d5878bb0207e1f2
>>">Are you with me? Rush in your IMMEDIATE support now. >>>

For Florida,
Ron DeSantis

Friends -
I hate to be the bearer of bad news, but you need to know this:
