body:
I believe in Cheri Beasley
#

Friends, Cheri Beasley needs our support to pull ahead in North Carolina’s crucial U.S. Senate race. This is an open seat, and polls show Cheri and her opponent within the margin of error.
**I recently got back from rallying with Cheri and her campaign in Charlotte. Before I share a few words and photos from my trip, I have to ask:[Will you pitch in $10 or whatever you can spare to Cheri’s campaign to help flip North Carolina blue and expand our Senate majority?](https://act.cheribeasley.com/go/2567?c0=cb-em-oct22.I3buyh&refcode=em221024-1-T1&t=1&akid=2109%2E357359%2ExLQI81)**
**[DONATE $10](https://act.cheribeasley.com/go/2567?c0=cb-em-oct22.I3buyh&refcode=em221024-1-T1&refcode2=2109.357359.xLQI81&amount=10&t=2&akid=2109%2E357359%2ExLQI81)**
I joined Cheri and campaign volunteers to launch a door-to-door canvass to make sure voters turn out. We talked to folks at a local barbershop.
[](https://act.cheribeasley.com/go/2567?c0=cb-em-oct22.I3buyh&refcode=em221024-1-T1&refcode2=2109.357359.xLQI81&t=3&akid=2109%2E357359%2ExLQI81)
[](https://act.cheribeasley.com/go/2567?c0=cb-em-oct22.I3buyh&refcode=em221024-1-T1&refcode2=2109.357359.xLQI81&t=4&akid=2109%2E357359%2ExLQI81)
From there, we rallied with the community at a local high school gym.
[](https://act.cheribeasley.com/go/2567?c0=cb-em-oct22.I3buyh&refcode=em221024-1-T1&refcode2=2109.357359.xLQI81&t=5&akid=2109%2E357359%2ExLQI81)
[](https://act.cheribeasley.com/go/2567?c0=cb-em-oct22.I3buyh&refcode=em221024-1-T1&refcode2=2109.357359.xLQI81&t=6&akid=2109%2E357359%2ExLQI81)
I’ll share a few words with you that I said to the good folks in Charlotte:
**This is the election that will define the soul of our country, and the fault line for this election is Cheri Beasley. The fault line for this election is you and I. The fault line for this election is what we do in these last 15 days.**
Will you stand with me for Cheri Beasley?
Will you stand with me for America?
Will you stand with me for love over hate?
_If we do it in North Carolina, the whole nation will stand up and recognize that love still lives, that democracy still matters, and that hope still reigns supreme._
[**So please, stand with Cheri Beasley and me by donating whatever you can spare to her campaign. Help Cheri win in North Carolina. Help me expand our Senate majority. Help us stand up for America.**](https://act.cheribeasley.com/go/2567?c0=cb-em-oct22.I3buyh&refcode=em221024-1-T1&t=7&akid=2109%2E357359%2ExLQI81)

body:
| Friend,

What the progressive Left has done to our country is a shame.

**_Under President Trump and Senate Republican Leadership_** , our country was winning like never before, our southern border was the most secure it’s been in history, and authoritarian regimes and Communist nations __FEARED__ us.

But, in two short years, Biden and his radical Left-wing handlers in Washington have destroyed our economy, flung our southern border open to violent criminals and drug dealers, and have allowed international chaos to erupt throughout the world.

Hilmar, CA - 4:30 PM

Olives and Home, 8606 Avenue 280 Visalia, CA 93277

Crystal Palace 2800 Buck Owens Blvd Bakersfield, CA

But there are also racist bigots who want to demean me for the color of my skin and tear me apart because of my conservative viewpoints. I was attacked with racial slurs at a campaign event because I don't fit the Left's idea of what it means to be Black and conservative in America. While I was holding a press conference in front of an apartment building owned by Raphael Warnock's church - which has attempted to evict residents for late rent payments (sometimes for as little as $28) , a protester in the crowd said of me: | "He's a joke. He tap dances, and he's a house n*." The reporters who were covering our event said nothing. The local reporters who were covering our event questioned no one , despite urgent pleas from my campaign staff to do so. Unfortunately, this doesn't surprise me because that's the mainstream media for you. If Fox News had not reported it, the protester would've gotten away with it in plain sight. Fellow American, it's sad this is the type of environment we're running in, but it's a pattern from the Left we've seen numerous times throughout this campaign. With early voting already underway, Last week's protester viciously attacked me for the color of my skin because I'm willing to STAND UP for my conservative values and SPEAK OUT for the truth. Dear Peter,

I am writing to you to encourage your support of the Thomas More Society defense efforts for me and my family.

Since my arrest on September 23rd, and even prior to that, the Thomas More Society team has been such a gift to us.

From Matt Heffron, who handled my grand jury investigation, to Peter Breen, Thomas More Society attorneys have been a pure blessing in this legal battle.

What confidence it brings to me and my wife, knowing that my life and future lie in the hands of these talented and capable God-fearing men.

<http://tracking.mail.candidatesnews.com/tracking/click?d=WkFwGbeizDxpsuEQhaQT-KHFv8al4taZeHbxjQP_StEIl71iwG0Kdbqjicix8-_lmiaN3_sD-efvSGaUT_oFwfcuoeNuL3dT1XHED_C40BR66XgigDyE0JKt7QdgVYAfnuVscB6K5UpZjWCpn08-Qmb9PSUhF-n-Ikcg9kAStFQfCqQ80INZSYC2vOlMQr4Wecj3aRtW7YtV49IlsySHuz2ZlB5taG4zqCQgXWBl2sEaQmTqJFgvQQfsUVuPRRB8DAyoKNAOBmnI4LgG9xrEi8gzEweJGoxFCNV0Ib6JAfjm7TcAwNaLcacDQdh4wL4Yjg2>
Please prayerfully consider a donation enabling the Thomas More Society to not only represent me, but enable them to do so for you and others when and if the time is needed.

Founder Tom Brejcha could not have been more gracious and generous to me as he assured me that the Thomas More Society would handle all of my legal fees.

Also, the Thomas More Society secured for my defense the best lawyer in the city of Philadelphia, Brian McMonagle.

Together, Peter and Brian are fighting to secure my rights as a citizen, pro-lifer and father and ultimately yours too.

What a privilege it is to be called to this battle.

I know the Lord has a mighty plan for my life and this current cross that I bear.

God’s grace is truly sufficient and I believe that what man intended for evil, God intends for good (Genesis 50:20). That said, God uses His people to answer prayers.

Will you be an answer to prayer?

<http://tracking.mail.candidatesnews.com/tracking/click?d=WkFwGbeizDxpsuEQhaQT-KHFv8al4taZeHbxjQP_StEIl71iwG0Kdbqjicix8-_lmiaN3_sD-efvSGaUT_oFwfcuoeNuL3dT1XHED_C40BR66XgigDyE0JKt7QdgVYAfnuVscB6K5UpZjWCpn08-Qmb9PSUhF-n-Ikcg9kAStFQfCqQ80INZSYC2vOlMQr4Wecj3aRtW7YtV49IlsySHuz2ZlB5taG4zqCQgXWBl2sE5B1Ds2oC8EdY-DpzGSXxFrPfjRsrVqODXv43sC8K7H4gjbgNM5QRA97VC911wR9KZwqJs94AfWtPMG9UR-E_msg2>
Will you help TMS and their defense efforts of me by supporting the legal fund with your best gift today?

The Thomas More Society stepped out in faith by stating they will represent me and my battle against the tyranny of government.

I give thanks to God each day for Thomas More Society and their presence to me at this time. Please join me in supporting them financially and prayerfully.

Rest assured of my prayers for you as you partner with me, my family and this phenomenal legal team.

Your brother in the battle,

We’ll say it — **the rent is _too damn high_ , Peter!** Safe, affordable housing is out of reach for too many Oregonians. We see it every day in our communities. Tina’s got a plan for that — because she knows that **we simply all do better when we have a safe place to call home.** She is the only candidate with the detailed, thorough plans to build more housing, protect renters from extreme increases, and address the homelessness crisis by helping people move off the streets, tent by tent. Peter,
I wanted to make sure you saw our latest press release (below). It’s a look at where Wade has been making headlines recently and what voters in the District are hearing about our campaign.
Happy reading!
– Spencer DeMink
Communications Director | Wade Herring for Congress
P.S. We’re working hard to get the word out about Wade – if you haven’t had a chance to donate this month, contribute any amount today to help our GOTV efforts in the last two weeks of this race! [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/wade2022?refcode=whem1024]
FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE
October 24, 2022
Media Contact: Spencer DeMink - Communications Director
sdemink@wadeherringforcongress.com [sdemink@wadeherringforcongress.com]
Wade Herring In the News
Check out what Georgia is hearing about Wade Herring, Candidate for U.S. House GA-01, surrounding his appearance at two debates for the Congressional First District
WTOC: [https://www.wtoc.com/video/2022/10/20/watch-rep-buddy-carter-wade-herring-debate-wtoc/] Rep. Buddy Carter, Wade Herring debate on WTOC
Wade Herring stands firm throughout an hour-long debate at Savannah’s own, WTOC.
Fox 28: [https://fox28media.com/news/local/georgias-first-district-candidates-talk-early-voting-savannah-democratic-candidate-wade-herring-and-incumbent-rep-buddy-carter] Georgia's First District candidates talk early voting
Wade Herring spoke at a press conference with Savannah Mayor Van Johnson and State Rep. Edna Jackson to encourage people to vote. “The reason this is such an important election, so important to the future of our country is because of the issues that are at stake," Herring said.
Savannah Morning News: [https://www.savannahnow.com/story/news/politics/elections/2022/10/19/georgia-house-debate-how-buddy-carter-fared-against-wade-herring/10543536002/] 'Rubber stamp': Rep. Carter labels U.S. House challenger Herring as Biden proxy in debates
In two debates this week, Carter repeated many catchphrases while answering questions, but none with such dedication as "rubber stamp." In Wednesday's WTOC debate, Herring even joked about it during a rebuttal.
"I do not want to be a rubber stamp for anybody, and for those of you playing debate bingo, you can mark that card twice now.,” Herring said after Carter's second of many uses of the phrase Wednesday.
Atlanta Journal-Constitution: [https://www.ajc.com/politics/incumbent-carter-herring-face-off-in-1st-congressional-district-debate/CTTOWUM3WRG3RMU5YDW6HCFZPM/] Incumbent Carter, Herring face off in 1st Congressional District debate
Herring said he has worked to reach voters in every county in the district and has especially focused on reaching Black voters, who make up 70% of the Democratic electorate.
“I’m a learner, I’m a listener, and I’ve reached out to the voters across the district — all 15 counties, Black and white, young and old — to let them know that in me they will have someone who represents everybody in the district.”
Savannah Morning News: [https://www.savannahnow.com/story/opinion/columns/adam-van-brimmer/2022/10/22/us-house-rep-buddy-carter-downplays-january-6-actions-election-debate-wade-herring/10554987002/] Rep. Buddy Carter is 'not hearing about Jan. 6' on campaign trail. He must be deaf and blind.
In an op-ed, Adam Van Brinner writes “Rep. Buddy Carter claims he's "not hearing about Jan. 6" on the campaign trail ahead of the 2022 midterm election. He's probably not, but only because he only ventures into Republican echochamber. As his opponent, Wade Herring, said in a debate Wednesday night, Carter is "in a bubble."”
Savannah Morning News: [https://www.savannahnow.com/story/news/politics/elections/2022/10/19/georgia-house-debate-wade-herring-buddy-carter-january-6th-finance/10543537002/] 'He's in a bubble': Herring criticizes Carter for being out of touch with voters in debates
Democratic challenger for U.S. House seat pressed incumbent on his vote against certification of presidential election results and his downplaying of Jan. 6 U.S. Capitol attacks
"There's one rubber stamp on the stage, and it's you voting with the Republican Party 98% of the time. I'm going to be an independent thinker and a problem solver," Herring said Wednesday.
The Current: [https://thecurrentga.org/2022/10/19/second-carter-herring-debate-shows-stark-splits-on-issues-approaches/] Second Carter-Herring debate shows stark splits on issues, approaches
Herring hammered away at Carter’s opposition to measures in the recently passed Inflation Reduction Act that cap the price of insulin and allow Medicare for the first time in its history to negotiate drug prices, while touting himself as a learner, a problem-solver, and a conciliator.
GPB: [https://www.gpb.org/news/2022/10/19/gpb-morning-headlines-for-october-19-2022] Morning Headlines for October 19, 2022
The two candidates for Georgia’s U.S. House District 1 met Tuesday for a debate held by the Atlanta Press Club.
GPB: [https://www.gpb.org/news/2022/10/19/coastal-georgias-us-house-candidates-square-off-in-atlanta-press-club-debate-first] Coastal Georgia's U.S. House candidates square off in Atlanta Press Club debate, a first in 14 years
Much of Carter's remarks during the debate featured a common refrain: “rubber stamp” — a term he used six times throughout the half-hour matchup, to try to portray Herring as a would-be pawn for President Joe Biden.
Herring — a first-time candidate for elected office — pushed back, saying, “I am going to be a representative for the people of this district. I'm not a career politician like Mr. Carter. I'm going to be an independent thinker.”
WJCL: [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dqhNKPVsoWI] Buddy Carter, Wade Herring face off in GA District 1 debate
Savannah Morning News: [https://www.savannahnow.com/story/news/politics/elections/2022/10/18/buddy-carter-wade-herring-clash-us-house-district-one-debates/10522533002/] U.S. House debates: Rep. Buddy Carter, Wade Herring to argue over Trump, abortion
Since Jan. 6, 2021, U.S. House Rep. Buddy Carter has had a challenger in Savannah lawyer Wade Herring. With Election Day now just a few weeks away, the two will finally meet face to face this week in a pair of televised debates.
Savannah Morning News: [https://www.savannahnow.com/story/news/politics/elections/2022/10/18/buddy-carter-wade-herring-spar-1st-congressional-district-debate/10536559002/] 'Rubber stamp' vs. 'Career politician.' Carter, Herring trade barbs in U.S. House debate
The debate saw Carter, the four-term incumbent, on the attack. He branded Herring, a political newcomer making his first run for office, as a “rubber stamp” for the Biden administration multiple times over the course of the debate.
Herring breathed some fire himself, branding Carter a "career politician." Carter has held political office at the municipal, state or federal level for the last 28 years.
The Augusta Chronicle: [https://www.augustachronicle.com/story/news/politics/elections/2022/10/19/ga-midterm-election-2022-candidates-positions-kemp-abrams-walker-warnock/10466967002/] At a glance: Where Georgia midterm election candidates stand on issues, policies
Buddy Carter (U.S. House, Republican): Abortion should be illegal in every instance and Congress should ban federal funding for abortion services.
Wade Herring (U.S. House, Democrat): Abortion is health care and should be codified in law.
The Current: [https://thecurrentga.org/2022/10/18/coastal-ga-house-debate-sheds-light-on-healthcare-costs-personal-wealth/] Coastal GA House debate sheds light on healthcare costs, personal wealth
Candidates for Coastal Georgia’s congressional seat faced off in their first debate, which had the candidates answering tough questions on healthcare costs, inflation, and personal wealth.
Herring used his airtime to hammer Carter on voting with his party against bills that lower prescription drug costs, Herring claimed.
He asked Carter to explain why he voted against a measure to cap the cost of insulin, a drug to treat diabetes, to $35 under insurance or Medicare.
The Current: [https://thecurrentga.org/2022/10/17/carter-herring-debate-nights-arrive/] Carter-Herring debate nights arrive
In the current campaign, the confident Carter has seldom, if ever, referred to Herring by name. Herring, however, has put on his boxing gloves.
In a new 30-second television ad released last week, he dubs Carter, a licensed pharmacist, “Big Pharma’s Favorite Son.” The ad says Carter “made a fortune as pharmacy owner” then received campaign donations from pharmaceutical interests to help protect the industry’s profits.
GPB: [https://www.gpb.org/news/2022/10/14/buddy-carter-wade-herring-brandish-ambition-street-cred-for-seat-in-congress] Buddy Carter, Wade Herring brandish ambition, street cred for seat in Congress
In Herring, a 63-year-old Savannah attorney, Carter faces his most formidable and well-funded general election opponent since first running for Congress in 2014. Herring’s campaign has been clever, too.
Herring has drawn national attention and Gen Z buzz with a campaign TikTok video dubbing him the “chillest dude in America.” Herring also has demonstrated a command of facts and policies that Carter is unaccustomed to seeing in previous opponents.

| **FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE** CONTACT:JAMES MANETZJAMES@BRYCEREEVES.COM
---
| **Reeves Recalls Sounding the Alarm Early on Chinese Nationalists Stealing US Intellectual Property**
---
| **FREDERICKSBURG, VA- Oct. 24, 2022:** Today, the USDOJ (US Department of Justice) held a live press conference outlining charges against over a dozen defendants in a variety of cases relating to the intimidation of US residents and theft of US-based intellectual property. According to FBI Director Christopher Wray, ten of the defendants are Chinese officials. Each of the cases relate in some way to alleged CCP (Chinese Communist Party) attempts to steal intellectual property from US-based tech and academic institutions. There was also talk of a case of Chinese agents attempting to force a United States resident into returning to China. Attorney General Merrick Garland added that “The [People's Republic of China] has a history of targeting political dissidents and critics of the government who have sought relief and refuge in other countries." The various charges from the DOJ include attempts to steal confidential information from US-based tech companies, surveillance and harassment of a US resident in an attempt to intimidate them into returning to the PRC, obstruction, and attempting to target US citizens and coerce them into acting as Chinese agents. Senator Reeves, who carried [SB717](https://f1v3ff69.r.us-east-1.awstrack.me/L0/https:%2F%2Flis.virginia.gov%2Fcgi-bin%2Flegp604.exe%3F221%2Bsum%2BSB717/1/010001840b8a1bbc-14f68c47-ab4b-405f-b813-10b7c1546086-000000/pNeEr_gyLw5aX5c4URlaNh0OdyQ=292) this year seeking to protect Virginia academic institutions from theft of intellectual property by Chinese foreign agents, had this to say: “The threat posed by China to our academic institutions and our tech companies has never gone away. I attempted to secure public, Virginia-based universities from these sort of targeted attacks with [SB717](https://f1v3ff69.r.us-east-1.awstrack.me/L0/https:%2F%2Flis.virginia.gov%2Fcgi-bin%2Flegp604.exe%3F221%2Bsum%2BSB717/2/010001840b8a1bbc-14f68c47-ab4b-405f-b813-10b7c1546086-000000/YfjFMHnFeWTcskeBA2yAz_jL0mo=292), which would have required university employees to disclose any payments from foreign governments as well as prohibiting them from taking Chinese government grants. Unfortunately, the bill was killed before it ever saw the light of day on the Senate floor in an unsurprising party-line vote. These charges brought up by the Department of Justice validate the need for oversight and caution when it comes to the participation of foreign nationals in our educational system. My legislation would have done just that. I plan on reintroducing the legislation this year in the hopes that the Senate Democrats will wake up to reality and stop playing the identity politics game."
---
| ### Bryce Reeves is a small business owner, auxiliary sheriff's deputy in Culpeper County, former Army Ranger, and former Prince William County narcotics detective. He currently represents the 17th District in the Virginia Senate, which includes the City of Fredericksburg and the Counties of Albemarle (part), Culpeper (part), Louisa (part), Orange, and Spotsylvania (part). Senator Reeves serves on the Senate Committee on Rehabilitation and Social Services and sits on the Committees on Local Government, General Laws and Technology, and Privileges and Elections. _Gabby and me during her recovery_

Peter,

When I think about the toughest times in my life, I’m thankful I’ve always had a support system to help me through.

Being raised by two working parents who sometimes struggled to make ends meet wasn’t always easy.

Flying combat missions in Desert Storm wasn’t easy.

Watching Gabby fight so hard in the early days, weeks, and months of her recovery wasn’t easy.

Running for the U.S. Senate and having Donald Trump and National Republicans relentlessly attack me personally — that hasn’t been easy either.

But as a kid, I had my brother Scott.

In combat, I had my wingmen.

With Gabby, we had our whole community offering support.

And in these campaigns, I have you.

I could not do this without you, Peter. You probably didn't wake up this morning thinking you’d make a donation to my campaign, but I really need you if we’re going to defeat our Republican opponent and hold this seat.

**_[Peter, can you split a $25 contribution between my re-election campaign and the Democratic Party of Georgia before our next fundraising deadline? | | Dear fellow American,
Asked by a reporter in 1860 how he had acquired his extraordinary rhetorical skills, Abraham Lincoln credited his study of Euclid. While studying law in Springfield, Lincoln explained, he became convinced that the ability to demonstrate the truth of things was essential to the good practice of law. Consequently, Lincoln left his job, retired to his father's cabin, and did not return until he could "give any proposition in the six books of Euclid at sight." By studying Euclid, we improve our ability to reason soundly--plus, in my experience, the study of Euclid can be great fun. That's why Hillsdale College has produced a free online course on the topic **" Mathematics and Logic: From Euclid to Modern Geometry." ** Through** "Mathematics and Logic: From Euclid to Modern Geometry,"** you will learn the importance of deductive reasoning as a foundation for pursuing knowledge in all fields of learning, as well as in everyday life.

[View this message in your browser](https://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2z5e5nnennrbfg4db5njv2oblifbvn3iton6v3jc8_rp2ash2s8gb2sbgeppef9t56ej3fctmekp76t1heipnacpne4pqcdtlmui34thgmipnadt4sbp65thnmloj8d1jc9hb7d3l6oomcotme8qj9d9jc9q39olnm9rj6tb4e5pr8obnmmrjfkjge9h6cs5icpoe9cr3cup7cphh6iqr6o3ncdj3ao5icpge1db3c3gbac9hmkorash1k8gn48n24hhm6or3clhm9pj1c8iv0)

Friend,
I just stepped off the debate stage, and it's now clearer than ever -- Charlie Crist is dangerous for Florida.

His allegiance to the far-Left's extreme agenda puts Floridians at risk of facing the same fate as other failed blue states around the country.

On every topic, Charlie Crist takes the most extreme stance -- right in line with the Democrat Machine.

[**STOP THE BIDEN-CRIST AGENDA**](https://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2z77v3c1dpg6ll3sfv2bnrhpbdmjc1d4928fon7co_rp22sh2s8i66or3cdim6p76c5h2bs)

Over the course of the night, Charlie cemented for Floridians that:
* He votes 100% of the time with Joe Biden, and like the rest of the Democrats, he wants the government to control your kids. If it were up to Charlie, Florida schools would subject students to forced COVID jabs and indoctrination with woke ideologies.
* If it were up to Charlie, Florida would be a sanctuary state. He cares more about advancing Biden's open border agenda than keeping Floridians safe.
* Charlie's jailbreak agenda is in lockstep with the radical pro-crime views of Soros-affiliated prosecutors who are allowing criminals to wreak havoc in cities across our nation. His rejection of law and order would put Floridians in danger.
* Charlie spent the last two years serving as a rubber stamp for the Biden Regime and wants nothing more than to bring the Biden Regime's destructive policies to Florida.

What's more, Friend, _**Charlie only showed up to work 14 days this year**_ , because he isn't interested in performing the duties of the many offices he has run for in his political career spanning five decades.

_**Not surprising coming from Biden 's biggest cheerleader.**_

Throughout the night, Charlie dutifully played his role as a political puppet for the Biden Regime.

Since day one, Charlie has praised Biden's failed policies and declared at every opportunity that he considers Joe Biden the "greatest president of our lifetime" -- yes, the same Biden who has been plunging our country into a downward spiral since he took office.

Charlie made clear that he will take his orders from a puppet who can hardly read from a teleprompter.

_**Truth be told, Friend, I'm wary of anyone who matches Biden's agenda, rhetoric, and confused, empty gaze. I think I can speak for most Floridians when I say they don't want another Joe Biden infiltrating our state.**_

[**STOP THE BIDEN-CRIST AGENDA**](https://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2zidj7mrsdv3deoo6rrp60ful5kcg3dhgu4d6o210_rp22sh2s8i66or3cdim6p76c5h2bs)

My opponent talked a lot about decency, Friend, I'm not really sure what's decent about locking people in their homes, destroying their businesses, and keeping children out of school.

Aside from comparing himself to Tom Brady and Jesus Christ, I can't think of anything more ridiculous than Charlie Crist asking Floridians to trust him.

In the end, Charlie lost the fight to shut down schools, lost the fight to shut down businesses, lost the fight to lock people in their homes, and now, we need to come together as Floridians to deliver his destructive policies a loss once and for all.

__**[Stand with me to Keep Florida Free! Rush in an immediate donation now-- trust me, this is the single most important thing you can do.](https://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2zdh39rrmvbcmqm2tbnkgbfp9pn9al7imurbhn3d0_rp22sh2s8i66or3cdim6p76c5h2bs "Stand with me to Keep Florida Free! Rush in an immediate donation now — trust me, this is the single most important thing you can do.")**__

Thank you for your support,
Ron DeSantis

| | Dear fellow American, Asked by a reporter in 1860 how he had acquired his extraordinary rhetorical skills, Abraham Lincoln credited his study of Euclid. While studying law in Springfield, Lincoln explained, he became convinced that the ability to demonstrate the truth of things was essential to the good practice of law. Consequently, Lincoln left his job, retired to his father's cabin, and did not return until he could "give any proposition in the six books of Euclid at sight." By studying Euclid, we improve our ability to reason soundly--plus, in my experience, the study of Euclid can be great fun. That's why Hillsdale College has produced a free online course on the topic **" Mathematics and Logic: From Euclid to Modern Geometry." ** Through** "Mathematics and Logic: From Euclid to Modern Geometry,"** you will learn the importance of deductive reasoning as a foundation for pursuing knowledge in all fields of learning, as well as in everyday life.

And your gift matters even more because... Fellow American,

When running a campaign for the first time, there’s a real slap-in-the-face moment where one questions if this is all worth it.

Spending countless hours finding the right people to help with the campaign, organizing fundraisers, buying supplies, driving to every town on multiple occasions to meet with as many constituents as possible, and working a full-time job - **it can take a lot out of you.**

But my good friend [**George Logan**](http://links.georgeloganforcongress.com/u/click?_t=ab154d37b4f04f71ab6ab4c65effe590&_m=86a2afca38f94d02b05dd488564577c5&_e=bWE4p7VNd-gzcI0-ib6EPpeR-jnaeETwHC7LGjQTXH7sDrLGcQDrPdMssBimR5aHFY7nBMTjcp3kMjbMbtqUYn2Vsla8AtNFdlmZHxaAoVuP6uiTf-21IcJ908AWw-UziYjvqTIu-G1oIptpFr9zKHlx7S_xwqKf0KNfO9PC1DOUidjT3J4yymfK3pfNAGhX239tetIfTRt_o3wyvr7NIVTVUpz4veKaVJOoOcL5CFgXq1McY6A_WUuxVMAko7mAh7FE9EISUoqXLnrfBWGaayFo4SXZj6oERW8cEzVQAlgE_MTM9fcVG0wEMQKcPoGdGjOSVJ7AI07KhwU3q8YiUsxSL7QBwf66kMliFpVhsYy_928UhGCIEVPgwROVkwGBXDKPAhXMngesPae2-Y-xuKR6LvWiyNeusxgxufsP3Wc%3D) who is running for Congress in CT-05 has not let any of the normal campaign challenges stop him from pushing ahead. # Capitol Report
October 24, 2022
---
|
---
| **From Senator Steven Roberts:**
Our community is hurting today in the wake of the shooting at Central VPA High School. Our immediate priorities must be the emotional support we can give to survivors, families, and our neighbors as we make sense of this senseless tragedy. The Department of Mental Health Disaster Team has been deployed to the area and is working with local and regional agencies, including the American Red Cross. My office will continue to assist our state and local agencies to share resources regularly.

The resources below were shared with our office from the Missouri Department of Mental Health to assist in supporting members of the community in the wake of this tragedy. Please do not hesitate to contact us directly.

For crisis emergencies, please dial or text 988. Help is available.

Stay safe. We will get through this together.

Steve

| **Resources for Survivors, Youths, and Families**
* **_Tips for Survivors: Coping With Grief After a Disaster or Traumatic Event_** —In this tip sheet, SAMHSA defines and describes grief, discusses ways of coping with grief, and explains complicated or traumatic grief. The tip sheet also offers relevant resources for additional support.
[https://store.samhsa.gov/product/Tips-for-Survivors-/SMA17-5035](https://robertsforstl.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=6e3f7ee3b541518ea63c7e773&id=f6da691d9f&e=a088917f89)

* **The Impact of Disaster and Mass Violence Events on Mental Health** —Intended for mental health and substance use disorder treatment professionals, this online article from the National Center for Posttraumatic Stress Disorder (PTSD) summarizes research on common reactions to disasters. The article identifies common reactions in disaster-affected communities and describes how reactions increase and decrease in communities over time, as well as highlighting risk factors for longer term reactions.
* [https://www.ptsd.va.gov/professional/treat/type/violence_trauma_effects.asp](https://robertsforstl.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=6e3f7ee3b541518ea63c7e773&id=f915e02a9b&e=a088917f89)

#
* **_Tips for Talking With and Helping Children and Youth Cope After a Disaster or Traumatic Event: A Guide for Parents, Caregivers, and Teachers_** —This SAMHSA tip sheet can help parents, other caregivers, and teachers recognize and address problems in children and teens affected by a disaster. The tip sheet describes reactions that are common in young survivors at different ages, as well as how to help children cope with these reactions.
[https://store.samhsa.gov/product/tips-talking-helping-children-youth-cope-after-disaster-or-traumatic-event-guide-parents/sma12-4732](https://robertsforstl.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=6e3f7ee3b541518ea63c7e773&id=f3c7ab6c78&e=a088917f89)

* **Understanding Child Trauma** —This web page from SAMHSA presents statistics on child trauma, which may be experienced as part of a natural or human-caused disaster, and lists signs of traumatic stress in children and youth. It also offers tips for parents and other caregivers for helping children and youth to cope with trauma. Links are also provided to downloadable infographics in English and Spanish provided by the SAMHSA National Child Traumatic Stress Initiative.
[https://www.samhsa.gov/child-trauma/understanding-child-trauma](https://robertsforstl.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=6e3f7ee3b541518ea63c7e773&id=05396ef5e7&e=a088917f89)

* **_Coping after Mass Violence_** —Written for parents and families, this National Child Traumatic Stress Network (NCTSN) tip sheet provides information about common reactions to mass violence and self-care tips for those living in communities where an incident of mass violence has taken place. The tip sheet also includes external resources for individuals seeking further support.
[https://www.nctsn.org/resources/coping-after-mass-violence](https://robertsforstl.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=6e3f7ee3b541518ea63c7e773&id=e5b2ff90ad&e=a088917f89)

* **_Parent Guidelines for Helping Youth after the Recent Shooting_** —In this 3-page tip sheet released shortly after a shooting, the NCTSN describes how such an event may affect children and teens as well as parents and other caregivers. The tip sheet lists reactions common among people of all ages, offers coping tips for caregivers, and suggests ways for caregivers to support children and youth in talking about and managing their reactions.
[https://www.nctsn.org/resources/parent-guidelines-helping-youth-after-recent-shooting](https://robertsforstl.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=6e3f7ee3b541518ea63c7e773&id=59f39c72de&e=a088917f89)

This resource is available in Spanish at [https://www.nctsn.org/resources/guia-para-los-padres-para-ayudar-los-jovenes-despues-de-un-tiroteo-reciente](https://robertsforstl.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=6e3f7ee3b541518ea63c7e773&id=c0c73dd5e1&e=a088917f89).

* **_Talking to Children about the Shooting_** —In this tip sheet, the NCTSN provides suggestions to parents and other caregivers for talking with their children in ways that help them to make sense of and cope with their reactions to a shooting. The tip sheet also identifies reactions common in children and teens to shooting incidents.
[https://www.nctsn.org/resources/talking-children-about-shooting](https://robertsforstl.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=6e3f7ee3b541518ea63c7e773&id=fb404e1980&e=a088917f89)

* **_Tips for Parents on Media Coverage_** —In this tip sheet, the NCTSN explains the effects that media coverage of a violent incident may have on children and teens and suggests ways for parents and other caregivers to help children and teens manage reactions to media coverage and the violent event. The tip sheet also includes tips for families with involvement in a violent incident.
[https://www.nctsn.org/resources/tips-parents-media-coverage-shooting](https://robertsforstl.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=6e3f7ee3b541518ea63c7e773&id=50bccb9cbb&e=a088917f89)

* **_Psychological First Aid for Schools (PFA-S) Field Operations Guide, 2nd Edition_** —Developed by the National Child Traumatic Stress Network (NCTSN) and the National Center for Posttraumatic Stress Disorder, this guide defines PFA-S, a model school communities can use to support students, their families, and staff immediately after a natural or human-caused disaster. Appendix C of the guide includes handouts for responders, parents and families, and students after a disaster.
[https://www.nctsn.org/resources/psychological-first-aid-schools-pfa-s-field-operations-guide](https://robertsforstl.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=6e3f7ee3b541518ea63c7e773&id=90586bca7b&e=a088917f89)

* **_Age-Related Reactions to a Traumatic Event_** —In this information and tip sheet, the NCTSN provides an overview of how children and adolescents may react to a traumatic event, including a natural or human-caused disaster that they experience as traumatic. This resource describes reactions typical within specific age ranges and offers tips for families, doctors, and school personnel to help children and adolescents cope.
[https://www.nctsn.org/resources/age-related-reactions-traumatic-event](https://robertsforstl.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=6e3f7ee3b541518ea63c7e773&id=f5f30a3faf&e=a088917f89)

* **_Once I Was Very Very Scared_** —This book for young children introduces several animal characters (e.g., squirrel, turtle, dog) who have gone through traumatic experiences, including disaster trauma, and are experiencing different reactions. It can be used by parents and other important adults in the lives of children to talk about difficult and traumatic experiences and support children in coping. The book is available in several languages other than English.
[https://piploproductions.com/stories/once](https://robertsforstl.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=6e3f7ee3b541518ea63c7e773&id=178f7378aa&e=a088917f89)

* **PFA: Parent Tips for Helping School-Age Children after Disasters** —This handout lists reactions children may have to disasters, ways parents can respond helpfully to these reactions, and examples of things parents can do and say to support their school-age children after a disaster. The handout is part of the _PFA Field Operations Guide_.
[https://www.nctsn.org/resources/pfa-parent-tips-helping-school-age-children-after-disasters](https://robertsforstl.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=6e3f7ee3b541518ea63c7e773&id=1af74a4b7f&e=a088917f89)

Spanish: [https://www.nctsn.org/resources/pfa-consejos-para-padres-como-ayudar-ninos-de-edad-escolar](https://robertsforstl.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=6e3f7ee3b541518ea63c7e773&id=cbf1a05097&e=a088917f89)

* **_Recovery From Large-Scale Crises: Guidelines for Crisis Teams and Administrators_** —In this tip sheet, the National Association of School Psychologists (NASP) describes what to expect in schools after disasters and other crises and how school crisis teams and administrators can support the school community in coping and recovery. NASP identifies steps administrators and crisis teams can take at different points after the crisis, from immediately after the crisis to more than a year later.
[https://www.nasponline.org/resources-and-publications/resources-and-podcasts/school-climate-safety-and-crisis/school-violence-resources/recovery-from-large-scale-crises-guidelines-for-crisis-teams-and-administrators](https://robertsforstl.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=6e3f7ee3b541518ea63c7e773&id=19e25ed09d&e=a088917f89)

clean_body: Resources for survivors, youths, and families in wake of school shooting | | | | | | | Capitol Report October 24, 2022 | | From Senator Steven Roberts: Our community is hurting today in the wake of the shooting at Central VPA High School. Our immediate priorities must be the emotional support we can give to survivors, families, and our neighbors as we make sense of this senseless tragedy. The Department of Mental Health Disaster Team has been deployed to the area and is working with local and regional agencies, including the American Red Cross. My office will continue to assist our state and local agencies to share resources regularly. The resources below were shared with our office from the Missouri Department of Mental Health to assist in supporting members of the community in the wake of this tragedy. Please do not hesitate to contact us directly. For crisis emergencies, please dial or text 988. Help is available. Stay safe. We will get through this together. Steve | | Contact Senator Roberts 201 W. Capitol Ave., Rm 329 Jefferson City, MO 65101 (573) 751-4415 Steve.Roberts@senate.mo.gov | | | | | | | | | | | | Resources for Survivors, Youths, and Families Tips for Survivors: Coping With Grief After a Disaster or Traumatic Event —In this tip sheet, SAMHSA defines and describes grief, discusses ways of coping with grief, and explains complicated or traumatic grief. The tip sheet also offers relevant resources for additional support. The Impact of Disaster and Mass Violence Events on Mental Health —Intended for mental health and substance use disorder treatment professionals, this online article from the National Center for Posttraumatic Stress Disorder (PTSD) summarizes research on common reactions to disasters. The article identifies common reactions in disaster-affected communities and describes how reactions increase and decrease in communities over time, as well as highlighting risk factors for longer term reactions. Tips for Talking With and Helping Children and Youth Cope After a Disaster or Traumatic Event: A Guide for Parents, Caregivers, and Teachers —This SAMHSA tip sheet can help parents, other caregivers, and teachers recognize and address problems in children and teens affected by a disaster. The tip sheet describes reactions that are common in young survivors at different ages, as well as how to help children cope with these reactions. Understanding Child Trauma —This web page from SAMHSA presents statistics on child trauma, which may be experienced as part of a natural or human-caused disaster, and lists signs of traumatic stress in children and youth. It also offers tips for parents and other caregivers for helping children and youth to cope with trauma. Links are also provided to downloadable infographics in English and Spanish provided by the SAMHSA National Child Traumatic Stress Initiative. Coping after Mass Violence —Written for parents and families, this National Child Traumatic Stress Network (NCTSN) tip sheet provides information about common reactions to mass violence and self-care tips for those living in communities where an incident of mass violence has taken place. The tip sheet also includes external resources for individuals seeking further support. Parent Guidelines for Helping Youth after the Recent Shooting —In this 3-page tip sheet released shortly after a shooting, the NCTSN describes how such an event may affect children and teens as well as parents and other caregivers. The tip sheet lists reactions common among people of all ages, offers coping tips for caregivers, and suggests ways for caregivers to support children and youth in talking about and managing their reactions. This resource is available in Spanish at . Talking to Children about the Shooting —In this tip sheet, the NCTSN provides suggestions to parents and other caregivers for talking with their children in ways that help them to make sense of and cope with their reactions to a shooting. The tip sheet also identifies reactions common in children and teens to shooting incidents. Tips for Parents on Media Coverage —In this tip sheet, the NCTSN explains the effects that media coverage of a violent incident may have on children and teens and suggests ways for parents and other caregivers to help children and teens manage reactions to media coverage and the violent event. The tip sheet also includes tips for families with involvement in a violent incident. Psychological First Aid for Schools (PFA-S) Field Operations Guide, 2nd Edition —Developed by the National Child Traumatic Stress Network (NCTSN) and the National Center for Posttraumatic Stress Disorder, this guide defines PFA-S, a model school communities can use to support students, their families, and staff immediately after a natural or human-caused disaster. Appendix C of the guide includes handouts for responders, parents and families, and students after a disaster. Age-Related Reactions to a Traumatic Event —In this information and tip sheet, the NCTSN provides an overview of how children and adolescents may react to a traumatic event, including a natural or human-caused disaster that they experience as traumatic. This resource describes reactions typical within specific age ranges and offers tips for families, doctors, and school personnel to help children and adolescents cope. Once I Was Very Very Scared —This book for young children introduces several animal characters (e.g., squirrel, turtle, dog) who have gone through traumatic experiences, including disaster trauma, and are experiencing different reactions. It can be used by parents and other important adults in the lives of children to talk about difficult and traumatic experiences and support children in coping. The book is available in several languages other than English. PFA: Parent Tips for Helping School-Age Children after Disasters —This handout lists reactions children may have to disasters, ways parents can respond helpfully to these reactions, and examples of things parents can do and say to support their school-age children after a disaster. The handout is part of the PFA Field Operations Guide. Spanish: Recovery From Large-Scale Crises: Guidelines for Crisis Teams and Administrators —In this tip sheet, the National Association of School Psychologists (NASP) describes what to expect in schools after disasters and other crises and how school crisis teams and administrators can support the school community in coping and recovery. NASP identifies steps administrators and crisis teams can take at different points after the crisis, from immediately after the crisis to more than a year later. | | | COMMUNITY RESOURCE LIST The has a COVID-19 Community Economic Relief Fund. The only way we’re going to win this thing is if we do it together. So please, add your name to sign up for updates from my reelection campaign and show that you stand with Democrats. Having raised two daughters as a single dad, I understand the challenges Nevadans -- and so many Americans across the country -- are facing. name: Team AOC
subject: Youth vote in November
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez for Congress
body:
Young people could tip the balance.
# [](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/143?refcode=em20221024-3527-header&t=1&akid=3527%2E2526796%2E4Gl4kb)
It was a big weekend in California.
With the election just 15 days away, Alexandria traveled to California to help get out the youth vote before the crucial midterm elections.
[](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20221024.iNWD__&refcode=em20221024-3527-P_FND_EVT_END&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&akid=3527%2E2526796%2E4Gl4kb)
Re-electing progressives like Representative Katie Porter to Congress and Karen Bass for Los Angeles Mayor is crucial to maintain our majority in Congress and be able to pass policies that support working people — from capping insulin prices at $35/month for those on Medicare, to expanding the Child Tax Credit. **And young people could tip the balance.**
Alexandria is working around the clock to not only win her own race, but also to support our allies across the country by mobilizing young voters. [If you’re able to, can you chip in $6 right now to support Alexandria and our work to mobilize young voters in California and beyond before the election on November 8?](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20221024.iNWD__&refcode=em20221024-3527-P_FND_EVT_END&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=3&akid=3527%2E2526796%2E4Gl4kb)
**[Contribute $6](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20221024.iNWD__&refcode=em20221024-3527-P_FND_EVT_END&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=22&akid=3527%2E2526796%2E4Gl4kb)**
**Alexandria has made it one of her goals to show young people that our government and our democracy _can_ work for them.** That means having elected officials who are responsive and represent their voters, not special interests. It means having an economy that actually works for working people. And it means successfully communicating when we pass meaningful legislation.
Turnout among 18 to 24-year olds nearly doubled between the 2014 and 2018 midterm cycles, and now we need to keep this momentum for 2022.1 This high turnout must continue in order for Democrats to keep control of Congress and to win state races around the country where reproductive freedom, climate, and justice are on the ballot.
Alexandria is one of the best messengers to mobilize young voters about the stakes of this election, and with your help, we can reach even more young people before November 8. [Please chip in $6 or anything you can today in these crucial 15 days. ](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20221024.iNWD__&refcode=em20221024-3527-P_FND_EVT_END&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=23&akid=3527%2E2526796%2E4Gl4kb)
With thanks,
Team AOC

body:
John Hoeven's insider trading actions are borderline and deserve greater scrutiny. | | |
---
| Hi ,

In case you missed it, _Business Insider_ rated every member of Congress on their financial conflicts and transparency. **John Hoeven** was given a yellow rating for his insider trading activities and for his senior staffer who violated the federal conflict-of-interest law known as the STOCK Act. Yellow means caution — their actions are borderline and deserve greater scrutiny.

**North Dakota** deserves better.

As your Senator, I will make support efforts to eliminate trading by members of Congress and restore North Dakota's rating to green.

I would be honored to represent you in the US Senate and** restore integrity** for North Dakota's elected representation.

---
| [Please help put us in the green!](https://katrinaforussenate.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=2bb537a705e300eb5ec0192d9&id=588a8c8c02&e=101b417fd1 "Please help put us in the green!")

He has time for insider trading but doesn't show up for debates or the people of North Dakota.

Katrina Christiansen

body:
[1]Stacey Abrams for Governor

Derek,

What we’re seeing on the ground here in Georgia is truly historic. We’ve
seen hundreds of thousands of voters come to support Stacey and her vision
— despite all of the hurdles Brian Kemp has put in our way.

And if the trend we’re seeing right now continues, we’ll be well on our
way to unprecedented election numbers this November. But we’re going
against the modern-day architect of voter suppression — and we need to be
prepared for what Brian Kemp and his cronies throw our way now that the
strength of our team is clear.

[ https://act.staceyabrams.com/go/5405?refcode=sa_em_221024_B5_VoterSupression_S1_T1_HQ_30open&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=&firstname=Derek&lastname=Willis&addr1=&city=&state=&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&amount=5&amounts=5%2C25%2C50%2C100%2C250&t=1002&akid=14922%2E1862389%2Em7S5sY ]Our final fundraising numbers lock in tomorrow, and we need to raise $1
million to overcome Kemp’s attacks, mobilize voters and win this race.
Anything you give today — $25 or even $5 —
will go towards hitting our goal.

[ https://act.staceyabrams.com/go/5405?refcode=sa_em_221024_B5_VoterSupression_S1_T1_HQ_30open&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=&firstname=Derek&lastname=Willis&addr1=&city=&state=&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&amount=5&amounts=5%2C25%2C50%2C100%2C250&t=1003&akid=14922%2E1862389%2Em7S5sY ]DONATE

The past year has shown us that there is nothing permanent about our civil
liberties or civil rights in this country right now. Decades-old
precedents are being thrown out by the highest court in the nation. Our
voting rights are in question.

And Brian Kemp has shown us what it means to take advantage of a
deteriorating democracy and use it for his own political gain.

As the architect of modern-day voter suppression, Brian Kemp has chipped
away at the rights of millions as an excuse to protect so-called “election
integrity.”

As Secretary of State, he purged some 1.4 MILLION voters from the rolls.
He intimidated and helped jail Black school board candidates for simply
exercising their right to vote. And as Governor, he’s passed one of the
most comprehensive voter suppression laws in the country, outlawing mobile
polling stations and trying to make it harder for voters to access the
ballot.

And at the same time, he’s touting historic the Early Vote numbers as his
own, completely disregarding the actual organizing on the ground of our
communities that’s making that happen,
Derek.

We need to show Brian Kemp, the media and the rest of the world that the
most dangerous thing facing Georgia right now isn’t “election fraud” or
whatever else he’s pulled from his far-right playbook, but four more years
of Kemp.

And right now, we need our supporters to dig deep and ensure we do just
that.

[ https://act.staceyabrams.com/go/5405?refcode=sa_em_221024_B5_VoterSupression_S1_T1_HQ_30open&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=&firstname=Derek&lastname=Willis&addr1=&city=&state=&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&amount=5&amounts=5%2C25%2C50%2C100%2C250&t=1004&akid=14922%2E1862389%2Em7S5sY ]That’s why we’re asking now,
Derek. Getting Stacey Abrams
elected and defeating Brian Kemp is going to take much more than watching
the results come in on television or speculating with one of your
neighbors about this race. By making a contribution of $5
to hit our $1 million goal before our fundraising numbers go public, you
can help pave the way for Georgia to make history this November.

With only 15 days left in this election, we’re counting on you. Let’s get
it done.

— Stacey Abrams HQ

body:
[ stdin# ][IMG]

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/340?t=1011&akid=3592%2E5885482%2Eb6dwMz ][IMG]

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/340?t=1012&akid=3592%2E5885482%2Eb6dwMz ]Tune-in to our LIVE National Organizing Call for a massive GOTV push
ahead of Election Day this Monday at 8:30pm ET/5:30 PT. Minnesota AG Keith
Ellison will dig into his fight for re-election against a hedge fund
lawyer who wants to criminalize abortion.

We’ll also hear from Megan Green, a 2016 Bernie delegate we helped elect
to the St. Louis Board of Alderman who’s now up against union busters and
big developer money in her run for board president.

Austin City Council candidate Zo Qadri and San Francisco School Board
candidate Gabriela López will join us to talk about their races and the
importance of electing progressives at every level of government.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/340?t=1013&akid=3592%2E5885482%2Eb6dwMz ]RSVP

★ ★ ★
Insider News from the Political Revolution!

--------------------------------------------------------------------------

HEADLINES: Dr. Oz TIED w/ Fetterman?? | Deadlocked: Mandela Barnes vs. Ron
Johnson | Far Right Weaponizes Crime | Ellison vs. Anti-Choice Extremist |
AZ Race Key to Climate | Green vs. Big Money in St. Louis | Rallies for
Democracy w/ MLK III | & MORE!

★ ★ ★

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/7758?t=1014&akid=3592%2E5885482%2Eb6dwMz ][IMG]

The polls in key races are getting downright scary as we head in the final
TWO weeks to Election Day. Whether we face a MAGA takeover or elect allies
to help us build on our work all depends on [ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/4972?t=1015&akid=3592%2E5885482%2Eb6dwMz ]what we do right now.

Critical Senate races like John Fetterman in PA, Mandela Barnes in WI,
Raphael Warnock in GA are showing polls deadlocked as the far right spends
big money to spread lies and weaponize crime in a time of economic
despair.

It’s up to us to circumvent the onslaught of false ads and directly engage
with voters on the facts and our solutions to the issues affecting their
lives.

That’s why Our Revolution is hitting the phones to send more than a
million calls and texts, sending out mailers, taking to social media, and
organizing on the ground to mount a [ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/7593?t=1016&akid=3592%2E5885482%2Eb6dwMz ]massive and strategic GOTV
operation.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/7758?t=1017&akid=3592%2E5885482%2Eb6dwMz ][IMG]

That’s also why we’ll be hitting the campaign trail with Bernie Sanders as
he rallies in states like NV, FL, WI, OR, CA, TX, PA and MI to make clear
an economic message to voters misled to believe Republicans have their
interests at heart.

Bernie’s right: to defeat extreme Republicans and their economic
propaganda, Democrats need to earn trust and votes from the working class.

As he wrote in [ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/7759?t=1018&akid=3592%2E5885482%2Eb6dwMz ]The Guardian: “you’re not going to have that support
unless you show you’ll take on powerful special interests and fight for
the millions struggling economically.”

As OR Executive Director Joseph Geevarghese said, “People are concerned
with putting food on the table and a roof over their heads. With Fetterman
and Barnes, we can authentically say ‘these are progressives who will go
to the mat for the policies that will improve your life’.”

We have a chance to defeat the far right, elect allies, and cancel out the
veto-power of corporate Dems like Manchin and Sinema. A MAGA Majority is
unthinkable. We can’t let national abortion ban author Lindsey Graham
replace Bernie as Chair of the Senate Budget Committee.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/4972?t=1019&akid=3592%2E5885482%2Eb6dwMz ]SIGN UP TO VOLUNTEER NOW!

★ ★ ★

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/7758?t=1020&akid=3592%2E5885482%2Eb6dwMz ][IMG]

Our work to flip Senate seats couldn’t be more vital — the race between
John Fetterman and Dr. Oz is getting tighter and Mandela Barnes is in a
dead heat with right-wing extremist Ron Johnson.

We’re raising $300K to power our voter turnout model to mobilize our list
of 413,251 voters in these two swing states. This is the concrete work
that can make the decisive difference in these tight races.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/7593?t=1021&akid=3592%2E5885482%2Eb6dwMz ]Donate to our Swing State Fund today!

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/7758?t=1022&akid=3592%2E5885482%2Eb6dwMz ][IMG]

Our research shows that if we connect with each voter 4 times — by phone,
text, mail, social media, and door-knocking — we can boost turnout by 11
percent.

The stakes couldn’t be higher, and there’s a real danger that many
progressive, independent, working-class voters will not be motivated to
turn out.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/7593?t=1023&akid=3592%2E5885482%2Eb6dwMz ]POWER OUR GOTV MACHINE

★ ★ ★

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/7758?t=1024&akid=3592%2E5885482%2Eb6dwMz ][IMG]

★ ★ ★

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/7758?t=1025&akid=3592%2E5885482%2Eb6dwMz ][IMG]

Minnesota AG Keith Ellison is one of our strongest progressive fighters in
the country — and he’s in a dead heat with a far-right extremist who’s
taking big money to slander him with an onslaught of ads.

As the donor class weaponizes crime against Ellison, we have people-power
on our side to reach voters directly with the facts. And, we hope you’ll
[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/340?t=1026&akid=3592%2E5885482%2Eb6dwMz ]join us LIVE with Keith on Monday to dig into this major race!

While Keith has never lost a criminal prosecution case, his opponent Jim
Schultz has never stepped foot inside a courtroom. The truth is: Schutlz
is a hedge fund lawyer who wants to criminalize abortion at 6 weeks,
defund corporate law enforcement, and gut consumer protections.

Meanwhile, Keith has worked to combat price gouging in the pandemic and
led the team that convicted former Minneapolis police officer Derek
Chauvin for the murder of George Floyd.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/7758?t=1027&akid=3592%2E5885482%2Eb6dwMz ][IMG]

As AG, Keith Ellison took on wage theft and put hundreds of thousands of
dollars back into the pockets of Minnesota workers. And, holding Big
Pharma accountable for the opioid epidemic — he’s won hundreds of millions
of dollars for Minnesota.

When a hedge fund landlord stopped repairing their properties, leaving
families without heat and subject to mold and lead paint, Keith stepped in
to defend Minnesotans.

When we say Keith Ellison is the people’s lawyer, that’s what we mean.
That’s the work Jim Schultz wants to defund.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/7758?t=1028&akid=3592%2E5885482%2Eb6dwMz ][IMG]

Our Revolution is working hard to make sure we turn out our 147,000
supporters in Minnesota to vote for Keith. Our Phone Bank Force has made
58k phone calls in the state, and we’ll be sending 100k texts and
postcards to 65k households.

Doing the people’s work earns you powerful enemies, and Keith is in a
fight to the finish. Can you step up to help re-elect Keith Ellison?

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/7681?t=1029&akid=3592%2E5885482%2Eb6dwMz ]VOLUNTEER FOR KEITH

★ ★ ★

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/7758?t=1030&akid=3592%2E5885482%2Eb6dwMz ][IMG]

In Arizona, we have two great progressives Sandra Kennedy and Lauren Kuby
running for seats on the little-known but powerful Corporation Commission
to regulate the utilities monopolies, snuff out corruption, lower energy
prices.

We have a chance to turn Arizona into a leader of the renewable energy
transition, and that’s why we’re shedding light on this race and the dark
money flooding it. The utilities want to buy these key seats, but we can’t
let them handpick their own regulators!

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/7758?t=1031&akid=3592%2E5885482%2Eb6dwMz ][IMG]

The electric utility APS spent more than $10M to defeat her in 2014 and
elect commissioners who voted to raise utility prices, [ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/7751?t=1032&akid=3592%2E5885482%2Eb6dwMz ]Marketplace
reports.

She came back to beat the big money in 2018, and now we have a chance to
re-elect her and add Lauren Kuby to make sure it never becomes known as
the “corruption commission” again!

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/7758?t=1033&akid=3592%2E5885482%2Eb6dwMz ][IMG]

Our Revolution is going all out in this key down-ballot race — and we need
your help! Let’s not miss this opportunity to put progressives in key
seats of power!

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/7726?t=1034&akid=3592%2E5885482%2Eb6dwMz ]PHONEBANK FOR KUBY & KENNEDY

★ ★ ★

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/7758?t=1035&akid=3592%2E5885482%2Eb6dwMz ][IMG]

Megan Green will join our [ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/340?t=1036&akid=3592%2E5885482%2Eb6dwMz ]LIVE National Call Monday to give us all the
details on her grassroots campaign to be President of the Board of
Alderman — and she’s up against an opponent flush with cash from
anti-union and big developer sources.

Megan was a Bernie delegate in 2016 and we were proud to help elect her to
the board in St. Louis, where she’s fought for a higher minimum wage,
reproductive freedom, domestic violence protections, legal marijuana, and
more.

While Megan is supporting hotel workers organizing with Unite Here Local
74, her opponent Jack Coatar is taking donations from their anti-union
bosses.

“He’s the big-money candidate in the race to replace Reed, who was the
big-money candidate before Coatar,” [ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/7753?t=1037&akid=3592%2E5885482%2Eb6dwMz ]STL Today writes. “Reed, of
course, is headed to a likely federal prison sentence for taking bribes in
development deals.”

In her time on the board, Megan helped pass a $15 minimum wage bill in the
city while Coatar voted against it. As board president, she would
strengthen the growing bloc of progressive power in St. Louis, ranging
from the mayor to US Rep. Cori Bush.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/7758?t=1038&akid=3592%2E5885482%2Eb6dwMz ][IMG]

Our Revolution Phonebank Leader, Amanda Walker, spoke to a voter in St.
Louis this week who expressed his frustration with the Democratic Party
and his concern about “the city getting dangerous” — which he blamed on
progressives.

By hearing out his concerns, Amanda was able to counter the rightwing
narrative weaponizing crime by explaining Megan’s position on prevention
and restorative justice. Like Megan says, good union jobs and economic
security makes stronger, safer neighborhoods.

The man agreed that police only come after something bad has already
happened and said he would consider voting. These are the conversations
that can plant seeds and combat the big money misinformation. We need as
many folks as possible to make calls and turn the tide!

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/6242?t=1039&akid=3592%2E5885482%2Eb6dwMz ]MAKE CALLS FOR MEGAN

★ ★ ★

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/7758?t=1040&akid=3592%2E5885482%2Eb6dwMz ][IMG]

We need to send reinforcements to grow progressive power in Congress — and
The Washington Post says we’re on track to do just that with Our
Revolution-endorsed candidates like Delia Ramirez, Maxwell Frost, Summer
Lee, Andrea Salinas, Summer Lee, Jasmine Crockett, Jonathan Jackson, Becca
Balint, Greg Casar and others.

Our volunteers are also working hard to elect progressives who are in
tough, competitive races — including Jamie McLeod-Skinner in Oregon’s 5th
District and Michelle Vallejo in Texas’ 15th. Winning these seats could
stave off a Republican majority in the House!

Bernie also has their back, saying of Michelle: “She believes in an agenda
that speaks to the needs of working people — that means passing Medicare
For All, bringing good-paying union jobs to the district, and protecting a
woman’s right to choose.”

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/7593?t=1041&akid=3592%2E5885482%2Eb6dwMz ]DONATE NOW HELP SEND MORE ALLIES TO CONGRESS!

★ ★ ★

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/7758?t=1042&akid=3592%2E5885482%2Eb6dwMz ][IMG]

★ ★ ★

OUR FREEDOMS, OUR VOTE!

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/7758?t=1043&akid=3592%2E5885482%2Eb6dwMz ][IMG]

This week, Our Revolution pulled off several actions and rallies across
the country demanding justice for the assaults on our democracy.

Martin Luther King III and Arndrea Waters King joined Our Revolution
Executive Director Joseph Geevarghese in addressing the crowd and media
gathered at The Capitol in DC on Thursday.

“We know right wing Republicans have a plan — they’re going after our
elections, they are picking extremists to serve on elections boards and to
take over key government positions,” Joseph told the crowd.

“Well, we have a plan too,” he said. “Our Revolution is leading a massive
get-out-the-vote drive in key states where rightwing criminals are trying
to take power. The only thing standing between US and THEM is Election
Day.”

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/7758?t=1044&akid=3592%2E5885482%2Eb6dwMz ][IMG]

Our [ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/7760?t=1045&akid=3592%2E5885482%2Eb6dwMz ]Harrisburg rally on Wednesday at noon was a great success! A
coalition of progressive groups including Our Revolution, Indivisible PA,
and Cumberland Valley Rising, came together to demand justice for January
6 conspirators.

Featured speaker Randall Hayes from the group March on Harrisburg drew
cheers when he insisted that Democrats must fight for Main Street, not
Wall Street, or we will see more insurrections and an increasingly angry
and embittered working class.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/7758?t=1046&akid=3592%2E5885482%2Eb6dwMz ][IMG]

At the Philadelphia rally on Thursday, Our Revolution PA activists Bo
Dimbach and Karyn Hollis were joined by Philly D.A. Larry Krasner, who
spoke about the need to enforce the rule of law when it comes to elites
clawing desperately to retain their power.

At the [ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/7761?t=1047&akid=3592%2E5885482%2Eb6dwMz ]Phoenix rally that day, our featured speaker was Rep. Ruben
Gallego, who stood up to insurrectionists and protected others on Jan. 6th
at the Capitol, and now he’s helping Arizona activists lead the fight to
defend democracy!

Other events were held this week in Phoenix, Manhattan, Dayton, OH, for a
total of 70 locations nationwide. Sunday, we’ll rally in [ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/7729?t=1048&akid=3592%2E5885482%2Eb6dwMz ]Cincinnati,

| [3X MATCH ACTIVE:
GOTV EFFORTS UNDERFUNDED -- GIVE NOW >>](https://links.messages.lcv.)
Peter -- polls are tightening in key states like Arizona, Pennsylvania, and Wisconsin that will decide control of the U.S. Senate this November.

We have a _real shot_ at electing environmental champions and defeating their extreme, pro-polluter opponents, but what happens on Election Day will depend on how many pro-environment voters we can turn out.

**But there 's a major problem: As it stands, our get-out-the-vote (GOTV) efforts are underfunded.** If it stays that way, we could lose races we otherwise could have won.

We're reaching out for help. We need to scale up our GOTV work in these final weeks and we need to do it quickly. **To pull that off, we need to raise $40,000 before the end of the month.** A group of donors has put up a challenge match to _triple every contribution_ until then.

[If everyone reading this right now pitched in -- even $5 -- we'd blow through that goal in minutes. Donate to LCV Victory Fund today -- your contribution will be tripled >>](https://links.messages.lcv.)

This is absolutely critical -- we can't let up on our GOTV efforts if we're going to help pro-environment candidates win on Election Day. But if we don't hit our fundraising goal now, we may not have a choice.

**Right now, resources are tight.** We're expanding our efforts in states where we need to win. In races this close, whether the environmental movement goes to the polls will decide the outcome. We can't afford to pull back -- we need to keep going until Election Day. |
---
**[**TRIPLE YOUR IMPACT
TO GET OUT THE VOTE**](https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/k_)**

Here's what we're doing in just a few of the Senate battlegrounds we're working in:
* In **Pennsylvania,** we're _expanding_ our field organizing program as the polls tighten in that critical open race. The latest _Emerson College_ poll gives Lt. Gov. John Fetterman just a 2-point lead over Mehmet Oz, one of LCV Victory Fund's _Dirty Dozen_ list of the _worst_ anti-environmental candidates.
* In **Arizona,** we're knocking on doors and running ads to get out the vote for environmental champion Senator Mark Kelly, who's in a close race against Blake Masters, a Trump-endorsed, anti-environmental extremist.
* In **Nevada,** our field organizing program is growing to turn out even more pro-environment voters for climate champion Senator Catherine Cortez Masto in her race against climate change denier Adam Laxalt. _FiveThirtyEight_ rates this race as a true toss-up -- what we do now will decide who wins.

Peter -- these aren't the only races we're hoping to win, but if we lose these three, our path to securing an environmental majority in the Senate gets a whole lot tougher.

[Please contribute to our GOTV efforts today -- when everyone pitches in, even donations of $5 are a big help. Your contribution will go _three times as far_ if you chip in to help us in this final stretch >>](https://links.messages.lcv.)

We can't thank you enough for fighting alongside us during this election.

Onward,

Pete Maysmith
Senior VP of Campaigns
LCV Victory Fund

Over a hundred people witnessed a spicy debate that hit hard on issues
| | | | | | | | [ ](https://trk.klclick2.com/ls/click?upn=u4dgWLvf-2F9xYmewse6tZcz4FH8utc08VzXw1nD5Ao0k5kWl7tUDbgAKsfnJ-2B0mh0eLr9sB5sialAtZyMoAiXkQ2lIfzsJ8xBHm-2BKh7MdUFXgyjIolTpwOx-2FIAhJKoubKY97i_XwU9lPq5-2Bze3gI64ohlV0cQwWAuBAU7ADIvj2CS7ymhPNoyNNs9JMNQ4Sbb-2BxTu6RxkjmEI5QdzmbFRn9RJuC5ZScgP6jG2TPT5Ngue2gB3bhtC0Mwz33l9MQL9rJjvC8Oa55lONZw0XwLwIMBaLJOikE3Sis3L8iQeeOtIgBsCYkSLqG4iTrMajd4j7z4-2BiZI-2B125OP4zRwvYg2JYY-2FnSMqRvSq1ZjIFHFMUz6VxFGVMERLlT5wuRR6BBwwZVMvN3Nnbjr6vpAqLx8jLKQUDFkJsljbEPcO-2Fuzng0kVCGOxLJEtL4Z4G-2FzahC1mFDs93-2Btl-2BxFK1RxMNghEwZ6vlDwLsX90MNVrfew3fLYWdm53pMLyiHbbzueOhnIWp6UZGCts5JrVIMYdfLlAzse96It9-2FtkBH-2BSlMZQa6aeHEbc-3D)
